typeValue.description: Snippet type value used in requests and responses.

writeHint.description: The strategic question this snippet type answers and how to shape it. Snippets are point-in-time strategic analysis of the company's position against its market and named alternatives: open with the judgment and give dated details only as evidence for it, never as a fact list.

EntityListFilter.description: Entity list filters and saved-view query state including semantic entity search. semanticQuery executes on POST /v1/entities/search; saved views persist it for replay. Every other reused EntityFilter surface accepts the base EntityFilter, which omits semanticQuery. There is no query field: send free text describing the companies as semanticQuery, a word of a company's name, legal name, slug, or alias as textSearch, or a known company name as entityName.

affinity.description: Affinity provider organization names accepted by the companies list filter. Affinity rows are member -> provider; use provider names here, not member names.

closedLast.description: Rank terminal entities (Acquired, Closed, Closed (Acquihire), Inactive) after every other textSearch or semanticQuery match, ahead of relevance and sort, except that an exact textSearch name, slug, legal-name, or alias match of any status ranks ahead of every weaker match; omitted means true. false ranks them by relevance alone. Filter them out with operatingStatus or suppressNonOperating.

employeeCountRange.description: Current workforce ranges; omitted matchMode is numeric-only.

entityName.description: Exact normalized match against entity brand, legal, or alias names.

hasFundraising.description: Filter to entities with fundraise activity.

investorPopulation.description: Opt in to Firms/Funds, a current source-stated investing mandate, or recorded non-grant direct/current-primary-managed investment participation. Omitted/false keeps legacy scope; explicit typeRecord intersects. Prose, legal form and missing funding establish nothing.

letter.description: First letter of the display name.

noteworthyOnly.description: When true, only operating companies or business lines with a real logo, founding year, and current headquarters that had notable activity in the last 48 hours.

originCountry.description: Countries an entity is from: its headquarters country or the country of its current origin (founding) address, never a legal seat alone. What a nationality adjective (Colombian startups) means; headquartersCountry is only where it is based now.

portfolioHeadquartersState.description: Portfolio-company headquarters state or region values.

qualityGate.description: Extra listing check: COMPANY_LISTING_READY or NONE (default, no check).

rankByProminence.description: Rank most prominent first (funding, stage, headcount, momentum, recent news, investor breadth), ahead of sort: what best, top, or most promising mean.

semanticQuery.description: Free-text semantic search phrase, this body's query text (there is no query field), such as "AI tools for dental clinics". To filter this search to companies by name, send this body's entityName field instead; to identify one record from a name, call lookupRecord (POST /v1/lookup) with name, which accepts no entityName. Executable on POST /v1/entities/search; saved views persist it for replay. A semantic page ranks a bounded nearest-neighbor window: totalElements counts the ranked candidates reachable through continuation, not every matching entity.

items.description: Lowercase URL slug that identifies the record.

standardizedClassification.description: Matches any one of these entries; combined with the other filters by AND.

suppressLateStage.description: Exclude public and acquired companies (including acquired subsidiaries); what startup means. Private companies at any round stay, as do companies without a recorded stage or operating status.

suppressNonOperating.description: Suppress entities with terminal operating status.

suppressZeroTotalRaised.description: Suppress entities with zero or unknown USD total raised.

textSearch.description: Non-blank company-identity search term: it matches only brand names, legal names, slugs, and name aliases (including near spellings of them), never descriptions, products, or topics. A topic, sector, or market word such as "climate" or "corporate card" returns no rows or name lookalikes here: filter by the industry, tag, mainProduct, or other classification fields, send the phrase as semanticQuery on POST /v1/entities/search, or ask natural search for plain-English or multi-constraint company requests.

typeRecord.description: Entity type filter. Organization expands to Company, Investment Firm, Nonprofit, Government, and Business Line; omit to include every entity type.

uniqueId.description: Matches any listed registry identifier; combined with other filters by AND.

url.description: Current URL to match by normalized host and path.

urlDomain.description: Current root domain to match when urlMatchMode=domain.

urlMatchMode.description: URL matching mode: hostPath uses host and path; domain uses the root domain. Omitted, it is domain when urlDomain is set, else hostPath.

urlType.description: Restrict URL matching to one URL type.

JobEnqueue.description: Accepted asynchronous app job enqueue response.

deduped.description: `true` when an earlier run answers this request instead of a new one; absent on routes that do not report deduplication.

maxRuntimeSeconds.description: Longest the accepted background write may run, in seconds, so a caller knows how long to keep polling `statusUrl`; absent on jobs that state no runtime.

statusUrl.description: Endpoint to poll for asynchronous job state and result.

SecCompany.description: Public-company identity facts from SEC EDGAR (legal name, former names, ticker, exchange, industry, incorporation, headquarters). SEC supplies no brand name, website, or summary text — those stay enrichment-owned and are not part of this shape.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, 10 digits with leading zeros. It stays the same across SEC data syncs.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (tax id), when SEC supplies one.

entityType.description: SEC entity type. `operating` marks a real operating company; `other` marks a SPAC, trust, holding, or shell filing vehicle.

filingHistoryStart.description: Date of the registrant's earliest EDGAR filing. EDGAR filing became mandatory for all registrants in May 1996, so a listing before this date predates the electronic record.

headquartersCity.description: Headquarters city from the SEC business address.

headquartersCountry.description: Headquarters country code; often null for US filers.

headquartersState.description: Headquarters state or country from the SEC business address.

headquartersStreet.description: Headquarters street address from the SEC business address.

isOperating.description: True when SEC classifies this registrant as an operating company, false for a SPAC/trust/holding/shell vehicle.

listingProspectus.description: The registrant's IPO prospectus: its first final prospectus (Form 424B4 or 424B1), reported only when an offering registration statement (S-1, F-1, SB-2, S-11) precedes it and no annual or quarterly report does. Null when EDGAR shows no such prospectus, including every company that listed before its EDGAR history starts and every follow-on offering.

matchedVia.description: How the query resolved to this registrant. TICKER includes a delisted ticker that only the registrant's past filings carry.

nameAlias.description: Former registered legal names from SEC `formerNames`, most recent first.

nameLegal.description: Registered legal name from SEC filings.

otherCandidate.description: Other registrants whose title also contains the name query (legal names) beside the exact title match that bound. Empty for a ticker resolution.

stateOfIncorporation.description: State or country of incorporation (SEC code).

TextTypeOption.description: A text type the text endpoints accept; entity rows include minWords, maxWords, rewriteHint, and paragraphShape when that type has length and paragraph rules.

maxWords.description: Maximum words allowed for this text type.

minWords.description: Minimum words allowed for this text type.

paragraphShape.description: Paragraph rules for this text type.

privateType.description: Whether the textType requires trusted read visibility.

rewriteHint.description: Advice for rewriting text that breaks this type's rules.

EntityTypeAlias.description: An entity type, its accepted alternative spellings, and how its public pages are addressed.

alias.description: Other spellings accepted for this entity type (case-insensitive).

canOwnPublicProductServiceRoute.description: Whether this EntityType can provide the parent route for a public Product/Service.

productServiceRouteSegment.description: Nested public route segment shared by Product and Service records.

publicPathPrefix.description: Published website family prefix. Product and Service retain the legacy `/companies/products-services` family metadata, not a standalone route; their pages require `{providerPrefix}/{providerSlug}/products-services/{slug}`.

EntityAcquisitionRole.description: Role of the path entity in the acquisition. Defaults to acquired (the company that was bought). Pass acquirer to list acquisitions made by the path entity, or all to list both sides in one page.

EntityAcquisition.description: Canonical acquisition event: scoped entity is acquired, acquirerEntity is buyer.

acquiredEntity.description: The acquired company (the entity in the request path); read-only.

acquirerEntity.description: The buyer; read-only. Mutations identify the buyer only via the flat acquirerEntityId UUID, never a nested entity object.

announcedAt.description: Acquisition announcement date or instant, retaining its stored precision.

asOf.description: Effective acquisition date the server derives on write: announcedAt, else completedAt, else the submitted asOf, as a calendar day; it can differ from the asOf written.

completedAt.description: Acquisition completion date or instant, retaining its stored precision.

investorJoinId.description: Identifier of one investor's participation in a funding round

isCurrent.description: Whether the buyer still owns the acquired company, not whether the company is operating. False retains the prior ownership event on this relationship.

publicSource.description: Published page behind this acquisition, read from the provenance event that wrote it; absent for internal sources.

status.description: Acquisition stage of the acquired entity, not the deal's transactionStatus

Address.description: A postal address of an entity or person.

addressLine2.description: Canonical suite, floor, or secondary address line.

association.description: Role-period associations for this physical address

id.description: Id of this listed row's first association; PATCH and DELETE address one association by its association[].id, so a row holding several roles needs one call each

isCurrent.description: Deprecated aggregate compatibility flag; true when any association is current

isHq.description: Deprecated legacy flag marking the current legal/registered seat (domicile), not the operating HQ; it retires on 2027-02-05. Read a current association[].role of domicile for the legal seat, and match enrichment.headquartersAddressId to enrichment.address[].id for the operating headquarters.

isPrimary.description: Deprecated legacy flag marking the current operating headquarters (dominant); it retires on 2027-02-05. Match enrichment.headquartersAddressId to enrichment.address[].id, or read a current association[].role of dominant.

EntityAnalysisReplay.description: One accepted current published result shown read-only beside the Research tab's paywall. The same global example is selected independently of the requested profile.

event.description: Retained legacy field, always empty. Conversation is withheld; publishedSection is a result, not a reply.

publishedSection.description: The accepted, current, visible snippet, with only its public source details.

section.description: The single snippet type displayed by this public example.

BlogPost.description: A blog post published by exactly one entity or person and collected during research. It is not an aVenture blog article.

author.description: Blog-post author when discovered by ingest

externalId.description: Stable external feed/item identifier when available

id.description: UUID of a link to an external blog article collected during research

lastFetchedAt.description: Last time ingest fetched or summarized this blog-post URL

mentionedEntityId.description: Entities mentioned in the blog-post body, excluding the owner

mentionedPersonId.description: People mentioned in the blog-post body, excluding the owner

owner.description: Owning record, nested ids only: owner.entityId or owner.personId — exactly one is set.

summaryGeneratedAt.description: Timestamp when summary was last generated

topic.description: Nullable Library topic key the article classifier assigned: funding, product, partnership, acquisition, leadership, legal, research, financials, careers, blog, or press. Rows classified before that classifier may still carry a web-crawl section key.

EntityClassification.description: Entity classifications grouped by bucket. Reads return current classifications by default; includeInactive=true adds inactive and historical ones.

geoLocationExposure.description: Geographic markets where the entity earns revenue and serves customers (e.g. North America, EMEA, APAC). This is the sales/market footprint classification — NOT the HQ or office location. HQ and office locations belong on the address record (enrichment.address), not this bucket. A London-headquartered company selling globally should have North America and EMEA here, not United Kingdom.

standardizedClassification.description: Standardized taxonomy classifications such as NAICS, SIC, or ISIC codes, with category and code metadata.

EntityClassificationSuggestion.description: Ranked classification suggestion derived from the entity profile and classification embeddings.

alreadyJoined.description: True when the entity already has this classification, current or historical.

classification.description: Suggested classification tag or standardized classification code.

rank.description: One-based rank within this suggestion response.

score.description: Composite embedding similarity score; larger values rank higher.

ContactDetail.description: One email address or phone number of a company or person. A signed-in subscriber reads the contacts of a publicly visible record through the metered list routes; a caller who may edit the owner also sees opted-out (suppressed) rows.

contactType.description: Kind of contact value: an email address or a phone number.

contactUsage.description: Whether a contact reaches its owner personally or at work. PERSONAL: a personal mailbox or phone, always for a public email service domain (gmail.com, outlook.com, icloud.com, ...). WORK: an address at a business, government, or non-profit domain, always for a government domain, by default for a company's website domain. UNDETERMINED: stated only after checking the domain and finding no evidence either way, never as a shortcut. The server applies PERSONAL and WORK itself when its rule decides.

contactValue.description: Stored value: an email trimmed and lower-cased, or a phone reduced to digits with an optional leading +.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the owner's primary contact of its type.

owner.description: The company or person this contact reaches.

suppressed.description: True when the email is on the sales-lead opt-out list: never contact it for outreach or marketing. Read live from the opt-out list, so an opt-out applies at once. Always false for a phone.

EnrichmentMode.description: Whether the run performs comprehensive enrichment or only selected tasks

EnrichmentPrompt.description: Optional steering prompt or cited findings for one company, product, or service enrichment run

finding.description: Facts you already read verbatim on an external source page for an entity, each with statement, sourceUrl, and exact quote; omit taskPresetKey to default to apply-cited-findings

userPrompt.description: Plain-language instruction for this run, such as an observed update and its source URL (newsUrlOriginal or web URL) or which facts to check first

HarnessRun.description: One research run on a company, Product, Service, or person

callerCanFollowRun.description: Whether you may read this run's details and activity

chassis.description: Agent framework this run executes on

chassisRouted.description: True when aVenture, not the caller, chose `chassis`

entitySlug.description: Slug of the profile the run produced

error.description: Why the run failed; null unless failed

execution.description: Executor of this research attempt; absent on older APIs

failureClass.description: Typed terminal-failure class from the harness retry classifier (e.g. runtime_cap, escalated, provider_capacity, context_overflow); null unless failed

firstStart.description: Set only in the response that starts the run: true the first time it starts, false when a worker restarts it; null in every other response

followUpAdmission.description: Whether follow-up runs from this run's latest finish have all been filed; runs finished by older engine versions stay PENDING

hasSourceDocument.description: Whether this run consumes an immutable private source document

lane.description: Admission class (interactive or background) on client-facing responses; Prefer: run-lane-origin returns the actual queue lane. Engine lifecycle responses always return the actual lane.

latestStatus.description: Latest research-loop progress as a free-form JSON string

llmApi.description: Language-model API format this run's calls use

maxScoutConcurrent.description: How many read-only research helpers the run may use at once

mode.description: Enrichment breadth selected for this run

model.description: Engine model; absent for direct execution

modelRouted.description: True when the requester left `model` to the auto router, which picks it again each time the run leaves the queue; null on engine lease responses

nextAttemptAt.description: Earliest re-claim time when waiting on retry backoff

researchAllowanceType.description: Research allowance this run reserved when it was filed: COMPANY or PERSON; null for a run filed without one

researchOutcome.description: How unsuccessful research ended: PARTIAL or BLOCKED, from its recorded failure class; null for other outcomes

resumeSafeUntil.description: Instant past which a warm resume is no longer guaranteed; the harness writes it with session_resume from the model's cache window. Warm-resumable now iff failed/stopped and this is in the future. Null when there is no resume window.

subagentModel.description: Model id of the run's read-only research and check helpers

subagentModelRouted.description: True when the requester left `subagentModel` to the auto router, which picks it again each time the run leaves the queue; null on engine lease responses

taskPresetKey.description: Research presets filed with the run

type.description: Run kind: ENRICHMENT for a research request a caller filed, TASK for a narrower run aVenture scheduled

url.description: URL of the company, Product, Service, or person under research

userPrompt.description: Optional instructions filed with the run

EntityFundraiseInvestorJoin.description: One investor's participation in one funding round.

amountInvested.description: Investor-level attributed amount invested in the fundraise transaction currency. Serialized as a plain JSON number such as 220000 or 123456.78; no currency sign, currency code, comma grouping, or abbreviated amount text is valid.

financialInstrumentType.description: Financial instrument/vehicle for this investor's participation in the round (e.g. SAFE, Preferred Stock, Convertible Note). Distinct from the round-level financialInstrumentType: a single round can record different vehicles per investor join — e.g. an accelerator batch holding a capped SAFE and an uncapped-MFN SAFE as two joins.

investor.description: Investor identity, nested: investor.entityId for a firm/fund investor or investor.personId for an angel — exactly one is set. investorName and investorSlug on this row name that investor; never read each id separately.

investorName.description: Investor display name, read from the investor's own entity record (brand name, else legal name) or person record (full name). Omitted when that record holds no name.

investorSlug.description: Investor profile slug, read from the investor's own entity or person record; open the profile with it instead of resolving investor ids one by one.

leadInvestor.description: Recorded lead/anchor flag. True records a lead role; historical false values may mean either non-lead or unrecorded leadership evidence. A false flag alone does not establish confirmed non-lead participation.

publicSource.description: Published page that supports this investor's participation, from the join's latest value write. Omitted when no published source is recorded.

EntityFundraiseTransaction.description: One funding round. ONE row per discrete round. An entity that raised pre-seed, seed, and Series A is THREE rows. Combined or rolled-up totals are never modeled here — total raised is a sum across rows.

dateAnnounced.description: Occurrence date for the round when known; null when unknown. Use the announcement date, otherwise the earliest source publication date announcing the round, preserving source precision.

dateFundingComplete.description: Source-stated funding completion date or instant, preserving source precision.

financialInstrumentType.description: Source-reported financial instrument persisted for this round.

investorAttribution.description: Investor-specific attribution when returned from investor-perspective investment views. amountInvested is not added to amountRaised; it is the selected investor's whole investment in this round: its joins here (one per vehicle, such as a CEA and a SAFE) summed. joinId names one of those joins.

investorCount.description: Greater of source and distinct-investor counts; null if both are unknown.

publicSource.description: Published page supporting this round, from its latest economic value write.

rawInvestorCount.description: Stored source-reported investor count; null when unknown.

rawRoundLabel.description: Stored source round label, before display derivation.

round.description: Display round label derived from the stored round label, round type, and financial instrument type (an 'Initial Public Offering' round of type IPO reads as IPO); it can differ from the round label written.

roundType.description: Source-reported classification persisted for this round (e.g. Public for a SPAC Merger); it is not derived from the round label.

unsupportedField.description: Proposed fields not admitted from the cited source, including dependent fields withheld to keep retained values consistent. Stored values for these fields are unchanged; do not resend the whole round.

InvestorPortfolioOutcome.description: Observed recipient status, with closed taking precedence over acquired, then public, then operating. UNKNOWN means no supported current-status bucket. Acquired and public are not dated exits; closed is not a proved investor write-off.

EntityFundraiseInvestorActivity.description: Investor-perspective activity aggregate for entity and person investors.

acquiredRecipientCount.description: Distinct recorded recipients currently Acquired or Acquired Subsidiary; not investor exits. Null until the status breakdown has been calculated.

attributedInvestmentCount.description: Count of participations with a USD-attributed investor-level amount — the coverage denominator behind totalAmountInvestedUsd, averageAmountInvestedUsd, largestAmountInvestedUsd, and smallestAmountInvestedUsd.

averageAmountInvestedUsd.description: Average investor-level attributed amount per participation, restricted to rounds whose transaction functional currency is USD. Null when no USD-attributed amounts exist for this investor.

closedRecipientCount.description: Distinct recorded recipients currently Closed, Closed (Acquihire), or Inactive; not investor write-offs. Null until the status breakdown has been calculated.

currentPortfolioCount.description: Legacy Operating-status recipient count, including public recipients; not current holdings. Use operatingRecipientCount.

largestAmountInvestedUsd.description: Largest single investor-level attributed amount, restricted to rounds whose transaction functional currency is USD. Null when no USD-attributed amounts exist for this investor.

operatingRecipientCount.description: Distinct recorded recipients currently Operating, excluding the public bucket; not current holdings. Null until the status breakdown has been calculated.

portfolio.description: Selected fresh public recipient cohort and paged sector/recipient evidence. Null when portfolioOutcome was not requested or this capability is unavailable. Its visibility and snapshot differ from the legacy stored activity totals.

portfolioCompanyCount.description: Distinct recorded recipients this investor has participated in, across all recipient operating statuses. Counts recipients, whereas totalInvestment counts distinct fundraise transactions.

publicRecipientCount.description: Distinct recorded recipients with current unconflicted Public ownership, or legacy Public status, excluding acquired/closed recipients; not exits. Unknown statuses are not inferred from funding. Null until the status breakdown has been calculated.

smallestAmountInvestedUsd.description: Smallest single investor-level attributed amount, restricted to rounds whose transaction functional currency is USD. Null when no USD-attributed amounts exist for this investor.

totalAmountInvestedUsd.description: Sum of investor-level attributed amounts (amount_invested) restricted to rounds whose transaction functional currency is USD. Null when no USD-attributed amounts exist for this investor.

totalInvestment.description: Recorded round participations, including acquisitions and grants; not holdings.

totalPortfolioExit.description: Legacy acquired-status recipient count; not investor exits. Use acquiredRecipientCount.

totalWriteOff.description: Legacy closed-status recipient count; not investor write-offs. Use closedRecipientCount.

EntityLogoType.description: Entity logo slot: SQUARE is the square icon read back as `core.image.logoSquare`; STANDARD is the horizontal wordmark read back as `core.image.logo`.

MediaUpload.description: Managed media asset reference with resolved CDN URL and target metadata

accuracy.description: Entity logo writes only: the brand-match verdict the write's gate computed on these bytes, including the VISION MISMATCH a brand-match override admits; absent on reads, photos, and thumbnails.

firstUploadedAt.description: Earliest time this company, person, or news item received an image in this slot.

path.description: Attached managed storage path; never an external image URL

squareOriginalValidated.description: True only when this read fetched and validated the stored entity SQUARE original; absent on ordinary metadata reads and other media slots.

targetId.description: Attached entity/person/news target id, when known

EntityPersonAssociation.description: One entity↔person association, naming both sides

associationId.description: Integer person-entity association join row id, not a person or entity UUID

endDate.description: Association period end, preserving source precision; any value means the association ended and isCurrent is false. Absent only while not terminated

entityAddress.description: The entity's addresses. Person detail includes at most one: the entity's current headquarters, else its most recently updated current address; GET /v1/entities/{entityId}/addresses lists them all

entityIsPublic.description: Whether the employer page is readable; false: show name unlinked

entitySlug.description: Lowercase URL slug that identifies the record.

isCurrent.description: True only while the association has no endDate; any endDate means it ended

personSlug.description: Lowercase URL slug that identifies the record.

startDate.description: Association period start, preserving source precision

titleId.description: Corporate title id for the association row

titleName.description: Job title text for this role (read-only).

CompetitorDegree.description: direct lists the subject's curated competitors; secondOrder lists records that compete with at least one of those direct competitors, which need not compete with the subject, ranked by how many direct competitors they share.

EntityResearch.description: Research findings for an entity: structured research details, written research snippets, and accelerator participation.

acceleratorParticipation.description: Accelerator programs the entity took part in, derived from its accelerator research records

detail.description: Structured research details the caller is allowed to see

snippet.description: Research text snippets for this entity

EntityResearchDetail.description: Research detail record for an entity.

asOfDate.description: Date the research detail applies to, preserving the source's calendar or timestamp precision.

currentEligible.description: Eligibility as a current fact at response time; multiple rows may be eligible. Select the first eligible row in the returned authoritative order.

decimalValue.description: Exact monetary amount as a plain decimal string. Absent on legacy Double-only facts; never reconstruct exactness from discreteValue.

derivedRange.description: Read-only range derived only for targetDateAbsolute detail rows

measurementBasis.description: Source-stated measurement/accounting basis; null means unknown.

publicSource.description: Published page behind this value, read from the provenance event that wrote it; absent for internal sources.

reportingScope.description: Source-stated reporting scope; null means unknown.

EntityResearchSnippet.description: Persisted research snippet row for one entity.

compliance.description: Character and word counts for this snippet and whether it meets its type's length and paragraph rules; null when not checked.

publicSource.description: Published page behind this value, read from the provenance event that wrote it; absent for internal sources.

SlugLocation.description: Current slug location for a resource

EntityText.description: A text record, such as a description, of an entity or person.

compliance.description: Character and word counts for this text and whether it meets its type's length and paragraph rules; null when not checked.

expandedText.description: Expanded row written with this summary by expandedWriterBrief, including its compliance. Null when this response does not represent a paired create.

expandedTextId.description: Id of the expanded row a summary create wrote in the same transaction from expandedWriterBrief; read it at GET /v1/entities/{entityId}/texts/{textId}. Null on every other response.

isCurrent.description: Whether this is the owner's current text of its textType; setting it clears the flag on the owner's other texts of that type.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the owner's primary text of its textType; setting it clears the flag on the owner's other texts of that type.

owner.description: Owning record, nested ids only: owner.entityId or owner.personId — exactly one is set, and no name fields. Writes are scoped by the owning entity/person route; owner is never a write field.

UniqueId.description: External identifier mapped to one owner (entity or person): for example a company's EIN, SEC CIK, or ticker symbol. Owner carries exactly one entityId or personId.

effectiveFrom.description: Source-stated beginning of this ticker assignment at supplied precision.

effectiveTo.description: Source-stated end of this assignment; null does not mean current.

identifier.description: Identifier value as issued by the registry (normalized per type).

listingStanding.description: Listing-specific source assertion, not entity ownership or operating status.

owner.description: Owning entity or person id; exactly one nested id is present.

shareClass.description: Source-stated ticker share class; unknown absent.

source.description: Attribution source label for the mapping, when recorded.

standingAsOf.description: Date from which the source says this listing standing applies, at the precision supplied.

venue.description: Source-stated ticker venue; exact spelling, unknown absent.

EntityUrlLink.description: A URL linked to an entity or person, with its status, crawl results, and source. Lifecycle state (current vs former, primary vs secondary) is encoded by `isCurrent` and `isPrimary` — `urlType` names only the platform (website, linkedin, and so on), and its write values come from GET /v1/url-types. Readers accept new platform types as deployments evolve. To record a rebrand or domain migration, retain the prior URL with the same `urlType` (typically `website`) and set `isCurrent=false, isPrimary=false`; never encode lifecycle in the platform type.

crawlCdnProvider.description: CDN provider from the latest URL probe.

crawlRenderMode.description: Render mode from the latest URL probe.

isCurrent.description: `true` = owner currently uses this URL; `false` = historical/former (rebrand source domain, deprecated platform handle). The lifecycle state lives here, NEVER in the `urlType` discriminator.

isPrimary.description: `true` = canonical/primary URL of this `urlType` for this owner. Only one row per (owner, urlType) may be `isCurrent=true` AND `isPrimary=true`. Retired rows are always non-primary, including when a write requests otherwise.

owner.description: Owning record, nested ids only: owner.entityId or owner.personId — exactly one is set, and no name fields. Writes are scoped by the owning entity/person route; owner is never a write field.

status.description: Latest URL status observation; a later probe may replace the submitted status.

statusChecked.description: Time of the latest URL status observation.

url.description: Absolute URL as stored, with the host normalized to the form the live site uses.

AgentHelpQuestion.description: A plain-English question about how to use aVenture, answered with references to the operations that do it.

model.description: Optional supported model id for the answer. Leave the field out for the server's model; a value that is not a supported model id answers 422.

question.description: The question to answer, in natural language.

resolve.description: True recommends the operation or workflow that does what the question asks, or asks a clarifying question, instead of writing an answer. It ignores model and has its own per-account limit.

scope.description: Optional scope restricting which operations the answer may recommend; null means all.

AgentHelp.description: Help answer with citations to the operations it draws on. Unsupported questions abstain (LOW confidence) rather than guess.

answer.description: Answer drawn only from the cited corpus; abstains when unsupported.

citation.description: Corpus evidence backing the answer; empty when the model abstains.

confidence.description: Confidence the answer is fully supported by the cited corpus. LOW signals an abstention.

resolution.description: The task or operation resolution when the question asked to resolve; absent for a generated answer.

IdentificationSubject.description: The company, Product, Service, or person to identify. Send the name, a URL it owns, or both, plus every location and source you have; a website or profile URL usually settles the answer without any model call.

context.description: Specific facts in plain words: product, industry, employer and title, or founder names. Generic words like startup add nothing.

email.description: Exact email address the record holds as a contact detail. Requires private visibility; when exactly one record of the requested kind holds it, that record matches before names or URLs.

employer.description: Companies the subject is known to work at; a person filing accepts a LinkedIn profile only when one of them appears in the profile's employer fields.

items.description: A company name or aVenture entity id the subject works at.

kind.description: Kind of record to identify when you know it: ENTITY for companies, funds, and firms (and their products or services); PERSON for people. Only that kind is looked up; typeRecord or productServiceProviderId implies ENTITY.

location.description: City, region, or country, such as Austin, TX. Tells namesakes apart; not proof on its own.

name.description: Name exactly as the source writes it, such as Acme AI or Jane Doe. Send name, url, or both; a name that is an absolute http(s) URL is read as url.

productServiceProviderId.description: Provider entity id for a Product or Service lookup. Omit it when the provider is unknown. With no typeRecord, searches both Product and Service. Invalid for a company type or a person lookup.

providerId.description: Deprecated: send productServiceProviderId, the name the entity duplicate-check and create routes use. Still read as productServiceProviderId; a request that sends it answers with Deprecation and Sunset headers.

role.description: Part the subject plays in the source: INVESTOR when the source lists it as an investor. Unlike typeRecord it keeps every record type a candidate, so a Company or Nonprofit that invests can still match. With it, a lookup with no url, filing, or sourceIdentifier binds a same-named Investment Firm or Fund over a record that does not invest; without a sourceNewsId it also answers NEEDS_REVIEW when the bound record shares its name with another live firm, or a visible record of its type family, unless the location's place names only the bound record's address and every namesake stores one. Without it, an Investment Firm or Fund typeRecord applies the firm preference alone. Omit it otherwise.

sourceDocumentId.description: Exact stored capture of sourceUrl, never an owned website. Requires capture-read authority and a matching successful evidence body; cannot accompany sourceNewsId. Private CSV rows require private body-read authority and their matching canonical relative body#row locator in sourceUrl. Bound lookups remain synchronous.

sourceIdentifier.description: Permanent source identity with idType and identifier for a catalog source-binding type. Legacy source may be omitted or null; non-null labels are rejected. Requires private visibility and resolves before names or URLs.

sourceNewsId.description: aVenture news id of the article that mentions the subject; an unknown id is a 400.

sourceUrl.description: URL of the article that mentions the subject; read from aVenture news when stored there, otherwise fetched. Private CSV evidence uses the canonical relative body#row locator with its matching sourceDocumentId, never an owned website.

typeRecord.description: Entity type to identify. A Product or Service never matches its provider organization, but a record stored under a neighboring type of the same family (Product or Service; Fund, Investment Firm, or Company) still matches, and a Business Line lookup sees both families. Invalid for a person lookup.

url.description: URLs the subject owns: its website, its LinkedIn company or person profile, an aVenture page, or a registry page. At most 10. Required when name is omitted. Put articles in sourceUrl.

Identification.description: Which existing entity or person satisfies the requested identity, type, and provider scope, how that was settled, and the candidates considered, most probable first.

acceptedOwner.description: The owner to bind without confirming: a match no language model settled whose record an exact id, URL, slug, or registry id proved, or whose name spells the requested name up to a trailing legal or group form (an Investment Firm also by its bare brand); or created when its name keeps the requested name as whole words. Absent otherwise: confirm the match or created record before binding it.

created.description: The new record a NO_MATCH subject with a proven own site was added as, or the existing one that already held its website. A new company is public and a new person hidden unless publishCreated says otherwise. Absent otherwise.

detail.description: One sentence naming what settled the answer or what the user must decide.

deterministicMatch.description: Whether this answer is a deterministic match to the scoped record. Absent on older stored responses; absence is not proof of a deterministic match.

duplicate.description: Other records that appear to describe the same subject as match. Empty when none were found.

enrichmentRunId.description: Research request filed for the created record; absent without created, when the lookup did not request research on it, and when the record is already public.

filing.description: Present only for callers that sent Prefer: respond-async. The identification is settled, but filing is pending. Poll statusUrl until the lookup job completes and use its identification; do not treat this as a final unfiled absence.

filingRefusal.description: Conflict kind that refused creating the shell, from ProblemDetail.details.conflictType. Absent when no typed conflict refused filing; detail retains the explanation.

inserted.description: Present only for callers that sent Prefer: respond-async. For a completed filing job, whether that request inserted created.

languageModelSettled.description: true when the match was settled on a second, slower review; confirm it before relying on it. Absent otherwise.

match.description: The matched record when status is MATCHED.

officialUrl.description: The subject's own website or profile page found in web search, or a supplied LinkedIn person profile verified against the subject's name and employer for a deterministic match. It may be a profile page on another site rather than the subject's own domain. Only the verified supplied profile may be attached to an existing person matched by name and employer.

status.description: What to do next: use the match, record that no match exists in this scope, or add evidence to settle an ambiguous identity.

urlHostForm.description: Results of live URL checks the server ran because verifyUrl=true; empty otherwise.

LookupJob.description: An async lookup job's state and, once COMPLETED, identified companies and people from its article or supplied names, or the identification of its subject.

failureDisposition.description: Whether retrying the failed lookup can succeed: TERMINAL when the job judged the failure not transient, TRANSIENT when a transient failure exhausted or lacked its retry budget; absent unless state is FAILED and the job recorded that decision.

failureReason.description: Why the job failed; absent unless state is FAILED.

identification.description: Subject jobs only: once COMPLETED, the identification returned for source.subject by POST /v1/lookup (kind in the JSON body), including requested filing and source-claim outcomes; absent otherwise.

limitReached.description: True when a bulk lookup returned its name bound; more names may remain. False does not prove that extraction found every name on a page.

maxNames.description: Most names a bulk lookup accepts; absent for older article jobs.

mention.description: Each identified company and person; bulk results are available while running.

namesFound.description: Distinct names found for a bulk lookup; absent on standard jobs.

namesProcessed.description: Names processed so far, including per-name failures.

news.description: Stored article behind a shared-article lookup, when known.

source.description: The article the job reads or names supplied for a bulk lookup.

sourceRead.description: Reading progress for an accepted, stored lookup of a shared article, post, or profile.

updatedAt.description: When the job last changed state.

LookupJobMutation.description: The article whose companies and people a lookup identifies. Send sourceUrl, sourceNewsId, or both; POST /v1/lookup/mentions also reads a recorded sourceDocumentId alone; lookup-only bulk jobs and POST /v1/lookup/mentions also accept mention instead. A job filed by Prefer: respond-async on POST /v1/lookup with kind in the JSON body carries that request's subject instead.

deterministic.description: POST /v1/lookup/mentions without maxNames only: identify extracted names using deterministic stages, without judgment, web-evidence identity or shell filing. Name extraction is unchanged. Lookup jobs reject true.

mention.description: Companies and people the caller already read, identified without sending the page or screenshot. Send them alone, without an article or file. On lookup jobs, maxNames is required and no records are created and no research is requested.

omitRecords.description: POST /v1/lookup/mentions only: true answers each name with only its name, mentionType, failureReason, and identification status, stage, match, officialUrl, and detail: no entity or person rows and empty candidate and duplicate lists. Defaults to false, the full answer.

sourceDocumentId.description: Id of a stored source document whose text is the article; send it alone. Only POST /v1/lookup/mentions without maxNames reads it. An event-stream request with Prefer respond-async, source-read accepts any signed-in user's own captured PDF; every other read needs editing rights.

sourceNewsId.description: aVenture news id of the article; an id that names no stored article is an error.

sourceUrl.description: URL of the article; read from aVenture news when stored there, otherwise fetched.

subject.description: Read-only: the subject of a POST /v1/lookup request with kind in the JSON body, sent with Prefer: respond-async, rolled over from a signed-in live lookup, or handed off for pending filing. This job preserves the route's options. Requests to create a job or read mentions must omit it.

MentionLookup.description: Every company, organization, investor, and person a page or screenshot names, each identified against stored records.

filing.description: Present only for callers that sent Prefer: respond-async. Identifications are settled but shell filing is pending. Poll statusUrl until the lookup job completes; merge its filing outcomes by mentionType and name.

mention.description: Each distinct name: the page's own company first, then the order the source shows them, with news outlets and the page's bylined authors last.

news.description: The stored aVenture news article the source page is, when it is one; absent otherwise.

profileAutoEnrich.description: On a shared LinkedIn or X profile lookup's source event and JSON answer: whether the server's profile policy (app.lookup-mentions.profile-auto-enrich-enabled) researches the profile at once. A caller that sends scheduleEnrichment=false and files research itself follows it. Absent on every other event and lookup.

sourceRead.description: Publisher reading state, available before the first name settles; a continuation is present only after its durable job commits.

truncated.description: True when the page names more than this answer holds: more names than one live lookup reads, or a body longer than the read limit. A lookup job with maxNames reads every name.

fundingLast30Days.description: Total positive funding announced by visible companies in the trailing 30-day window.

fundraiseRoundsLast30Days.description: Count of positive funding rounds announced by visible companies in the trailing 30-day window.

NewsFeedback.description: Feedback submission for a news article

NewsFeedbackAcknowledgement.description: Feedback acknowledgment for news articles - non-mutating response

NewsDetail.description: A news article with all of its detail fields.

analysis.description: Current shared article analysis, absent before publication.

entityMentionResolved.description: Resolved entity mentions — read-only display projections. News mutations attach entities only via flat entityJoinId values, never these nested objects.

linkerCompleted.description: Whether the entity linker completed, including an empty result.

personMentionResolved.description: Resolved person mentions — read-only display projections. News mutations attach people only via flat personId/personSlug values, never these nested objects.

NewsSubscriptionKey.description: Identifies one subscription to remove by its event name, arguments, and url.

NewsSubscriptionDetail.description: One of the caller's news subscriptions and its delivery state.

consecutiveFailureCount.description: Failed deliveries since the last acknowledged one or refresh.

cursor.description: Opaque watermark the next delivery resumes after.

id.description: Stable subscription id; sent as X-MCP-Subscription-Id.

lastError.description: Short cause of the latest failed delivery; null after a success.

nextAttemptAt.description: Earliest time the next delivery attempt runs.

refreshBefore.description: The subscription expires unless refreshed before this instant.

subscription.description: Event, arguments, and url; the unsubscribe request body.

updatedAt.description: Latest subscribe, refresh, acknowledged, or failed delivery.

verifiedAt.description: When the endpoint last answered the verification challenge.

NewsSubscription.description: Subscribe or refresh one webhook subscription to news newly linked to an entity. The same caller, delivery url, event name, and arguments always address the same subscription, so repeating the call refreshes it.

cursor.description: Opaque watermark from an earlier grant or event to resume after; null starts a new subscription from now and keeps an existing subscription's position.

ttlMs.description: Requested subscription lifetime in milliseconds; the server caps it.

cursor.description: Opaque watermark the subscription delivers after.

id.description: Stable subscription id; sent as X-MCP-Subscription-Id.

refreshBefore.description: The subscription expires unless refreshed before this instant.

truncated.description: Whether events between the requested cursor and now were lost.

NewsSubscriptionTestEvent.description: The receiver's answer to one signed sample entity.news.published event.

eventId.description: The sample's event id, equal to its webhook-id header.

PersonLookupBatch.description: Batch request for person detail enrichment. Each selector array accepts at most 200 values, and at most 200 selectors may be submitted across personId, slug, and url.

url.description: Person URL values

PersonDetailInclude.description: Profile panel to embed in a person detail read: graph, investorActivity, similar, blogPost, or investment.

PersonDetail.description: Full person detail: core identity, additional data, associations, and investments. Core fields are under core (for example .core.slug or .core.nameFull).

blogPost.description: Newest active blog posts first; present only when include names blogPost

coveringRunId.description: The queued or running full-research run covering this record; null when none, and always null on people embedded in another record.

graph.description: Precomputed person graph; present only when include names graph

investment.description: Investments associated with this person. When include names investment, these are newest first, the same rows as GET /v1/people/{personId}/investments?sort=date,desc&size=200 page 0: fewer than 200 rows is the whole list, otherwise continue at page=1 with the same sort and size.

investorActivity.description: Investor activity rollup; present only when include names investorActivity

nameAlias.description: Display and search aliases for this person

similar.description: Most similar people, highest score first; present only when include names similar

PersonFilter.description: Filters for listing and searching people, used by the GET, POST, and batch people endpoints.

additionalAssociation.description: Require a second, independent association of the same person, AND-ed with the primary association constraints, e.g. a past employer.

entityFilter.description: Constraints on the associated entity, as on POST /v1/search/natural/entities: a person matches when an association (current by default; selectable with tenure) points at an entity matching every field and visible in entity listings, such as yearFoundedRange, hasFundraising, or fundraiseActivity.totalRaisedRange. Omit for no associated-entity constraint.

includeUrl.description: Include URL links on each person

isCurrent.description: Legacy tenure filter; omit when selecting tenure explicitly.

nameQuery.description: Name eligibility independent of search; preserve it on replay.

personId.description: Specific person IDs; omit or use [] for no restriction.

personName.description: Exact normalized match against a person's full name or slug.

rankByEmployer.description: Rank people who run the most prominent matching employers first, ahead of sort (founders and management, then other operators, then board seats). Applies only when entityId, entitySlug, arrayFilter.entityName, or the entityId, slug, entityName, or fundraiseActivity.investorEntityId or investorName of entityFilter or additionalAssociation.entityFilter names the employers.

search.description: Search keyword or phrase. Single characters valid; stop words rejected.

semanticQuery.description: Semantic person search phrase. A semantic page ranks a bounded nearest-neighbor window: totalElements counts the ranked candidates reachable through continuation, not every matching person.

tenure.description: Tenure of the association title and employer match: CURRENT, PAST, or ANY. Omitted, titles match any tenure and employers current; isCurrent must agree.

PersonEnrichmentPrompt.description: Optional steering prompt for one person enrichment run

userPrompt.description: Plain-language instruction for this run, such as an observed update and its source URL (newsUrlOriginal or web URL) or which facts to check first

PersonGraph.description:
Precomputed professional-graph document for one person: career context per associated
        entity (entity facts, recent news, colleagues, similar entities with key people), plus
        co-investors. Lists are capped and pre-ranked server-side; the response is the display
        order. The graph is computed ahead of time; member names, images, and slugs are filled in
        from current person records when you read it. computedAt is null only when the graph has
        not been computed yet.

careerContext.description: One entry per entity the person holds or held an association with, current first

coInvestor.description: People who participated in the same fundraise transactions or invested in the same companies, ranked by overlap count and recency

computedAt.description: Instant the document was materialized; null only when no document exists yet and an asynchronous recompute has been requested

ResearchRunView.description: Shape of a research run listing: FULL pages full run rows; SUMMARY returns compact rows for polling

finding.description: Facts you already read verbatim on an external source page for an entity, each citing the page and exact text that support it. Omit taskPresetKey to default to apply-cited-findings, or send a preset from GET /v1/research/runs/presets; the run checks each quote against its page and writes only the facts it confirms. When the detail comes from an indexed news article or a page not read verbatim, send userPrompt instead.

mode.description: How broadly the run researches the subject; omit it for COMPREHENSIVE

model.description: Model id the run uses; omit it to use the default model

name.description: Name of the subject at url, such as Clarity Health; the run verifies it and uses it to pick the right subject when the site names several

taskInput.description: Requester values keyed by the selected task's input definitions. ENTITY binds from url and a supplied entityId must match it; a task declaring several ENTITY inputs binds one from url and takes each other as the keyed entityId of an existing record (404 when none exists). TEXT requires explicit text; a missing required or ambiguous supplied value is rejected before enqueue; omitted optional inputs stay unbound. Never infer values from userPrompt.

taskPresetKey.description: Research presets that focus the run, listed by GET /v1/research/runs/presets; omit them for a full run

url.description: Official website or profile URL of the company, Product, Service, or person to research; a URL no current record owns researches a new one

userPrompt.description: Optional steering prompt, such as an observed update and its source URL (newsUrlOriginal or web URL) or which facts to check first

AgentTaskPresetCatalog.description: Research presets available to the caller.

taskPreset.description: Available task presets. The field name is singular, but it holds a list.

HarnessRunDetail.description: Research run with the profile it resolved to

entity.description: Current public profile the run resolved to

followUp.description: Follow-up runs filed when this run last finished, and their ids

lastEventAt.description: Time the run's newest stream event was recorded; null when the run has no events. A running run whose value stops advancing has stalled

latestStatus.description: Latest research progress; null when none is available

provider.description: Parent organization's core record when the resolved entity is a Product/Service; null for every other entity type

publicUrl.description: Exact renderable public profile URL for the resolved entity

EntityAnalysisDraft.description: Private analysis for one research run, with section acceptance outcomes.

runId.description: Run that owns this private draft.

section.description: Current sections, each identified by its snippet type key.

verification.description: Acceptance and publication outcomes recorded for this draft version.

version.description: Latest analysis-section event sequence; zero before the first section.

EntityAnalysisSectionMutation.description: Replace a private analysis section with paragraphs or a finished writer brief.

citation.description: Stored source documents and verbatim evidence quotes.

figure.description: At most two figures grounded in the section's quotes; omit for no figures.

key.description: Exact research snippet typeValue, matching the section path key.

origin.description: Author hint; the server assigns origin from the credential.

paragraph.description: Catalog-ordered paragraphs; omit when supplying writerBrief.

writerBrief.description: Finished brief for the shared prose writer, supplied instead of paragraph.

EntityAnalysisSource.description: Public page behind a source document a draft quotes; never persisted in a draft.

publicSource.description: Published page URL and fetch times; absent for unavailable, private, internal, or legal sources.

sourceDocumentId.description: Source document UUID a draft quote points to.

HarnessRunTurn.description: One conversation turn; set exactly one of text or invocation

figure.description: True asks the analyst to also illustrate the section with figures

invocation.description: Analysis tool invocation instead of a text message

text.description: Nonblank user message within the conversation turn character limit

payload.description: The full stream event as a JSON string

SearchLayer.description: Optional answer layer for a natural-language entity search. `passage` adds the text passages, from public research snippets and linked news, that best answer the question about the subject entities, their peers, or the top results; `synthesis` adds a written answer grounded only in those records and passages, citing each, and implies `passage`. A competitor, market, or provider question ("who competes with X", "top X companies", "who provides X") is always ranked by the judged probability that each entity answers it, so `judgment` adds nothing beyond that; `web` adds web search evidence, and the companies those results name, before judging. Other questions ignore `judgment` and `web`.

FederatedNaturalSearch.description: Plain-English search across companies, people, and news, plus optional per-scope entity constraints and page sizes.

answerModel.description: Optional supported model id for the written answer, which also supplies the page heading, title, and description. Leave the field out for the server's model; a value that is not a supported model id answers 422.

cacheMode.description: Cache policy. use reuses earlier search work; bypass and refresh compute fresh results and are honored only for accounts with private-data access.

entityFilter.description: Explicit entity constraints for the entity scope only, as on POST /v1/search/natural/entities: caller-supplied fields override planner values. The person and news scopes ignore it. Terminal entities are suppressed only for category discovery; named and relational searches keep them, even with true. Explicit suppressNonOperating=false always includes them.

freshness.description: auto refreshes date-sensitive queries before cache admission; cached permits ordinary cache reuse. Explicit admitted bypass or refresh wins.

mode.description: Search strategy to run. Defaults to `auto`: the fast name layer runs first (a single-token query as keyword search, a multiword query as an exact normalized name) and the language-model planner runs only on a miss, so name lookups never pay for planning. Any other value forces exactly that strategy: `exact` and `keyword` skip planner model resolution and its rate limit. Entity and person natural-search take every value but `hybrid`; news and federated search accept only `auto` and `keyword`; content search accepts `auto`, `keyword`, `semantic`, and `hybrid` (`semantic` and `hybrid` only for one entity's or person's content).

model.description: Optional supported model id for planning the search. Leave the field out for the server's model; a value that is not a supported model id answers 422.

modelCatalogRevision.description: Model catalog revision this search uses for its model defaults and inference policy; null reads the current revision. Callers without private-data access always read the current revision. An unknown revision returns 404.

newsSize.description: News scope page size; defaults to 4, matching the aventure.vc search page, under the same page-size cap. Explicit null uses the size query parameter.

personSize.description: Person scope page size; defaults to 10, matching the aventure.vc search page, under the same page-size cap. Explicit null uses the size query parameter.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning effort for every model call this search makes: the query planner and the synthesis answer. Each call sends the nearest level its model supports, the lower one on a tie. Accounts without private-data access are capped at `medium`; higher values are lowered.

searchCatalogRevision.description: Search catalog revision this search uses for its global search policy and vocabulary; null reads the current revision. Callers without private-data access always read the current revision. An unknown revision returns 404.

sourceNewsId.description: The stored aVenture news article this search started from. Its approved public Company and Business Line mentions lead the entity scope as subjects in mention order. An unknown or non-public article, or one without such mentions, keeps the ordinary headline search. Other scopes and answer generation are unchanged.

tenantPolicyRevision.description: Runtime policy revision this search uses for the serving deployment's execution budgets; null reads that deployment's current revision. Callers without private-data access always read the current revision. An unknown revision returns 404.

FederatedSearch.description: Combined entity, person, and news search results, each from that record type's own search, with the search method used for each.

entityDetail.description: Public detail for Product/Service rows on the entity result page, in search rank order. Other entity types are not hydrated.

news.description: Page of news results from keyword search.

newsEntityMention.description: Public entities each news row on the page links to, in news page order; a row with no public entity link has no entry.

personDetail.description: Public detail for people on the person result page, in search rank order, with at most two public entity associations per person; person address and URL enrichment is omitted.

personLead.description: Whether people lead this page: the query names a person, a web-found person's profile shows, or the query asks for people by a search catalog people term.

provenance.description: Requested and executed strategy for each search scope.

qualifier.description: A prompt with rewritten queries offered beside a broad query's results, from the search catalog revision the search read; null when no qualifier rule matches.

section.description: Result sections from most to least relevant. People lead when `personLead` is true and come last otherwise. Companies, products and services, and investors follow the rank of each section's best entity row, so a name whose best match is an investment firm leads with investors; sections with no entity row follow in that same fixed order.

items.description: Result section a search page renders: people; companies (operating companies, business lines, nonprofits, and governments); products and services; or investors (investment firms and funds).

LinkSearch.description: Search results related to a shared article or page URL: the fetched URL, the search query synthesized from the page content, and the federated entity, person, and news results for that query.

query.description: Search query synthesized from the page content.

related.description: Federated entity, person, and news results for the synthesized query.

url.description: The fetched page URL after validation.

EntityNaturalSearch.description: Plain-English entity search plus explicit hard constraints. The planner may fill only filter fields the caller leaves unset.

filter.description: Explicit entity constraints. Caller-supplied fields override planner values; the planner fills only fields left at their canonical defaults.

search.description: The plain-English search request and the search method to use.

sourceNewsId.description: The stored aVenture news article this search started from. Its approved public Company and Business Line mentions are ordered subjects, rather than candidates judged from the headline. An unknown or non-public article, or one without such mentions, keeps the ordinary search.

NaturalSearchResult.description: Result of a plain-English entity search: how the query was interpreted, and the resulting page of entities.

answer.description: Written answer grounded in the subject, peer, and result records and the passages; null unless the request asks for the `synthesis` layer.

filing.description: Discovered companies this caller filed and their research runs.

hiddenNonOperatingCount.description: Distinct terminal entities hidden from the measured bounded candidate recall after other filters matched. Null when suppression was disabled or not measured; this is not a directory-wide total. Acquired subsidiaries are not terminal.

interpretation.description: Structured interpretation used to run the entity list query.

investment.description: Recorded investment participation supporting investor discovery. Each row keeps its entity or personal investor, portfolio company, transaction attribution, and query-matched offering evidence. Empty for other question intents.

judgment.description: Judged rows of the `result` page for a competitor, market, or provider question: the same entities in the same order, each with its judged probability. Empty for other questions.

passage.description: Passages that best answer the question, ranked by score; empty unless the request asks for the `passage` layer.

peer.description: Curated competitors of the single subject entity for `peer` questions; semantic look-alikes are the result page. Empty otherwise.

pendingWebQuery.description: Web searches for this question not yet stored; their evidence joins a later request. Empty without the `web` layer.

personLead.description: Whether this search is mainly about people; set only on entity events in the stream.

searchRequestId.description: Id of this search's stored record. Null when the search was not recorded.

subject.description: Entities the question is about, one per resolved subject name, in query order; empty when the question names none or none resolves.

PersonNaturalSearch.description: Plain-English people search plus explicit hard constraints. The planner may fill only filter fields the caller leaves unset.

filter.description: Explicit people constraints. Caller-supplied fields override planner values; the planner fills only fields left at their canonical defaults.

search.description: The plain-English search request and the search method to use.

PersonNaturalSearchResult.description: Result of a plain-English people search: how the query was interpreted, and the resulting page of people.

interpretation.description: Structured interpretation used to run the people query.

investment.description: Personal investment participation supporting the returned people. Firm portfolio activity is never attributed to employees. Empty for other question intents.

personLead.description: Whether people are the confirmed requested focus of this search.

profile.description: aVenture people resolved or filed from web-discovered LinkedIn profiles whom no returned person matches, grouped by `named` in query order. A search that has not run yet runs only for a signed-in subscriber with `layer=web`.

searchRequestId.description: Id of this search's stored record. Null when the search was not recorded.

SharedSearchMutation.description: Publish a query under a stable client UUID; retries return the same saved answer.

id.description: Stable sharing UUID generated once and reused across retries.

query.description: Plain-English query to run against public records and publish.

searchRequestId.description: entity.searchRequestId of the federated search response the sharing page showed. When that search was signed in, asked this query (ignoring case), and its shareable answer is still kept, the share publishes exactly that answer without searching again; otherwise it runs the default public search.

SharedSearch.description: A saved public search query and answer.

canonicalSlug.description: Slug of the canonical share of the same query, compared case-insensitively: the share named by the query's own slug, else the earliest share. Pages name it as their canonical URL; equals publication.slug on that share.

UniqueIdListingStanding.description: Source-reported standing of a ticker assignment, not the entity's operating or ownership state.

UniqueIdTypeAlias.description: An identifier type with its label, accepted spellings, whether it applies to entities or people, and its format pattern.

alias.description: Other spellings accepted for this identifier type on writes.

canonical.description: Identifier type value, as returned in responses and accepted on writes.

ownerScope.description: Owner kinds this identifier type may attach to.

pattern.description: Regex the identifier value must match, when constrained.

UrlTypeAlias.description: A URL type, its accepted spellings, and the website hosts that identify it.

alias.description: Other spellings accepted for this URL type.

hostDomain.description: Host domains used by URL inference for this urlType.

Search.description: Live web search request with cache controls

allowSuspectedShellStrip.description: Set true only when an unmarked amount in the search text is intentional.

bypassCache.description: Skip cache lookup and refresh from the search provider

cacheKey.description: Stable lookup text for cache keying when generated search text varies between runs

cacheMode.description: use permits cached provider evidence; bypass and refresh require a new provider search. Captured evidence is always archived. Legacy bypassCache=true wins.

cacheSource.description: Permit compatible cached results from ANY provider by default, or restrict to PROVIDER. The provider field independently selects live misses; bypassCache skips every provider's cache. document.provider identifies the serving source.

deep.description: Deprecated alias for `provider: EXA_DEEP`; `true` with any other `provider` is refused with 400.

deferredAiOverview.description: Wait in-request for Google's AI Overview when Google defers it to a follow-up request, as it does for most company and person lookups: one extra SerpAPI search per overview not already stored. An explicit `true` also reruns a stored search older than SerpAPI's one-hour cache to get a fresh token (its one-minute overview token expired and the cache would return it unchanged). Without it, no deferred overview is fetched; one an earlier fetch stored still comes back at no extra cost. A fetch that returns no overview is not retried for six hours. An overview Google returns inline always comes back in `aiOverview` at no extra cost. Exa results never carry one.

freshness.description: auto refreshes date-sensitive queries before cache admission; cached permits ordinary cache reuse. Explicit cacheMode bypass/refresh or bypassCache wins.

provider.description: Provider to search; omitted keeps the default, SerpAPI. EXA runs Exa's instant search with highlights and never falls back to SerpAPI: an Exa failure answers 503. EXA_DEEP runs Exa's slower, broader deep search (higher recall for market and provider questions, about 3-6 s) and falls back to SerpAPI on an Exa failure. Both Exa providers answer synchronously (`Prefer: respond-async` does not apply), are stored apart from SerpAPI results, and are charged like any search.

SearchOrderingPersonSortField.description: Ordering applied to a search result page: an optional relevance rank that precedes the sortable-column terms.

relevance.description: Relevance rank applied before any column term; absent when no relevance rank ran.

SortOrderPersonSortField.description: Single sort term: which enumerated sort field to use and whether direction is descending.

field.description: Sort field for this resource (entity list uses EntityFilter.Sortable / published sort keys).

SearchRelevance.description: Relevance rank that ordered a search page before any sortable column.

SearchMode.description: Search strategy for a natural-language search request. `auto` keeps the server pipeline (exact-name shortcut first, planner otherwise); `exact` matches entity or person names exactly with no planner and no embedding; `keyword` runs full-text search; `semantic` runs vector similarity; `natural` always runs the language-model planner; `hybrid` fuses keyword and semantic rankings by reciprocal rank. Entity and person natural-search support every mode but `hybrid`; news and federated search accept only `auto` and `keyword`; content search accepts `auto` (topic, type, relation, and year words become filters and any other words rank by full text), `keyword` (the full text of articles, posts, and fetched pages), `semantic` (one entity's or person's library pages by vector similarity of their fetched bodies), and `hybrid` (that owner's keyword and semantic rankings fused; each ranking is cut at the largest page size, so a hybrid search returns at most twice that many items, and it orders by fused rank only, ignoring `sort`).

SearchAnswer.description: Answer to a natural-language question, grounded only in the response's entity records and passages. A written answer always has a paragraph; when the evidence does not answer the question, LOW confidence paragraphs state what the cited evidence does show. No paragraph means the answer abstained: the answer check refused every drafted paragraph, a requested recorded-figure composition held no figure, or `provenance.answerUnavailable` is true. LOW confidence with paragraphs means the evidence answers only part of the question or at least one kept paragraph passed the answer check only below its acceptance bar.

citation.description: Evidence the paragraphs cite, in first-use order.

confidence.description: How fully the cited evidence answers the question.

description.description: Summary of at most 155 characters for a search-result snippet; source financial answers use a whole selected recorded proposition or a generic funding phrase. Absent when the answer abstains.

heading.description: The question as the answer page's heading: the asker's own words in title case, with record names in their stored casing; it never adds, drops, or corrects a word. Absent when the answer abstains.

paragraph.description: The answer's paragraphs in reading order, each citing the evidence it rests on; empty when the answer abstains. A first paragraph without `topic` is the lead, written as a standalone answer of one or two sentences that reads complete when shown alone; later paragraphs expand it by topic without restating it. Source financial answers render recorded funding facts literally; a requested company profile follows the lead as one quoted "Products and services" paragraph, then other recorded transactions and attributed unchanged admitted source passages; a recorded total is not a round.

relatedQuery.description: Up to five follow-up searches grounded in the cited evidence; empty when the answer abstains.

shareable.description: True when the answer has grounded paragraphs and the answer model did not judge the question advertising or promotion; only a shareable answer can be published as a public search page.

text.description: Every paragraph's text in reading order, separated by blank lines; read `paragraph` to place each citation beside the text it supports.

title.description: Page title of at most 60 characters naming the answer's subject, then the angle and scope its paragraphs cover. Narrative titles come from the writer; source financial titles use a whole selected recorded proposition or a generic funding title. Pages show it as the subheading under `heading`. Absent when the answer abstains.

intent.description: Question shape the planner read from the query.

interpretation.description: Human-readable summary of how the query was interpreted.

personAssociation.description: Return only the companies through which a person matching this people filter holds its primary association, such as startups founded by former Revolut executives.

unsupported.description: Constraint the planner could not translate into the canonical EntityFilter contract, and the planned constraints a zero-row search relaxed; null when every material constraint was supported and applied.

SearchJudgment.description: An entity that answers a competitor, market, or provider question, with the judged probability that it does.
