matchedOffering.description: Current public Product/Service that supports this answer.

probability.description: Judged probability, 0 to 1, that the entity answers the question.

webUrl.description: Stored web search result pages that name the entity; empty without `web`.

SearchPassage.description: Text passage ranked by semantic closeness to a natural-language question, read from its owning record.

label.description: Snippet type key for research snippets, or the article title for news articles.

publishedAt.description: Article publication time for news passages; null for snippets.

score.description: Cosine similarity between the question and the passage; higher is closer. Compare scores only within one response.

source.description: Record type that owns the passage text.

sourceId.description: Identifier of the owning snippet or news article.

text.description: Passage text: the snippet, or the article summary or excerpt.

url.description: Original article URL for news passages; null for snippets.

EntitySimilarityResult.description: Similar entity list row with the provenance that explains why it appears. Rows carry the EntityList projection; load full detail through the entity detail endpoints.

EntityList.description:
Entity row returned by list and batch-list reads. It includes core identity, additional
        data, research details, accelerator participation, and funding rounds, but not the
        relationship, newsArticle, person, sitemap, and research snippet sections that detail
        reads return.
         List rows show only current classifications; to see past ones, call the entity
         classifications endpoint with includeInactive=true.
         Addresses are a few current locations, not every office; use the entity addresses
         endpoint to list every office and association.

acquirer.description: Public buyer of the newest completed acquisition; null for announced or non-public buyers.

core.description: Core fields of the entity: identity, names, status, image, and source details

coveringRunId.description: The queued or running full-research run covering this record, whoever filed it; set only on federated search result and subject rows, null when none and on every other list read.

enrichment.description: Supplemental entity data — addresses, classification tags, funding, text content, and URL links

fundraiseRound.description: Fundraise rounds associated with this entity

provider.description: Fund manager firm or product/service provider; null otherwise.

research.description: Research findings for list rows, without the written snippets

semanticMatch.description: Why this row matched a meaning-based (semantic) search; set only on semantic searches.

Entity.description: Core fields of an entity: identity, names, status, image, and source details. An entity is our umbrella record for organizations such as companies, funds, investment firms and investors, accelerators, nonprofits, and government agencies, plus products and services connected to those organizations. Nested as .core inside EntityList for default list reads and EntityDetail for detail reads.

lastModifiedAt.description: Provenance-grounded last-modified watermark (schema.org dateModified). Advances only when a real, consumer-meaningful data point changes via a recorded provenance event — never on timestamp-only writes, migrations, or index refreshes. Pairs with createdAt (dateCreated) and grounds the sitemap lastmod.

nameAlias.description: All names this entity has been known by — current alternates, DBAs, former names, and rebrand-source identities. Naming history (e.g. `Metaphor Systems` for the current `Exa` entity) lives here; never as a separate relationship type or `formerName` field.

operatingStatus.description: Current operating status. Use Acquired Subsidiary when the entity was acquired and still operates; use Closed (Acquihire) when the entity was acquired for its team and shut down, rendering like Closed everywhere; use Acquired only when it is terminal, folded, or closed.

publicId.description: Stable, immutable public handle (e.g. `eV1StGXR8Z5a`). Never changes once assigned, unlike the slug. Null on responses that do not include it and on older records not yet given a handle.

publicUrl.description: Absolute public profile URL on the aVenture front-end, e.g. `https://aventure.vc/non-profits/{slug}`, derived from the typeRecord's canonical route family. Null when the route needs relationship context or the record has no direct public SSR route (Business Line, Organization, Product, Service, or a non-public slug). EntityDetail.publicUrl resolves Business Line parent context. A Product/Service has no standalone page: it is addressed only as `{providerPublicUrl}/products-services/{slug}` under its provider, because its slug is unique only per provider; the sitemap-urls slot paths already emit those child routes.

sitemap.description: Which of the entity's profile pages exist and are listed in the sitemap; set only on sitemap reads and null otherwise to keep responses small.

EntityEnrichment.description: Supplemental entity data — addresses, classification tags, funding, text content, and URL links

address.description: Current addresses. List rows carry bounded current locations for named roles, identification evidence, and card display, not every office or association history. Single-detail reads retain all current locations and their association history. Full-detail search carries only the headquarters row (headquartersAddressId); GET /v1/entities/{entityId}/addresses lists every row.

classification.description: Entity classifications. Single-detail and full-detail batch reads include history; list, default batch, and similar-entity reads may return only current classifications. Use GET /v1/entities/{entityId}/classifications?includeInactive=true for the full history.

fundingDetail.description: Funding aggregate: enrichment.fundingDetail.totalRaisedUsd is the USD sum of recorded round amounts with available FX rates, not a complete lifetime total when round amounts or rates are missing.

headquartersAddressId.description: Operating headquarters address id: match enrichment.headquartersAddressId to enrichment.address[].id. Absent when no current dominant (operating) address is on record, even when a domicile (legal seat) exists. Deprecated isHq marks the legal seat, not the operating HQ.

headquartersRemoteAsOf.description: When aVenture last verified that this entity runs no operating headquarters (a remote company); absent while a current operating headquarters is on record or no unexpired verification exists.

publicControllingParentId.description: Unique publicly readable current primary controlling parent with current Public eligibility, for a Business Line only; null when not proven. Derived from the current parent or acquirer relationship, never a listing or Public ownership claim on this entity.

EntityProfileStatus.description: Read-only profile status derived from stored kind, ownership, operating status, and a Business Line's proven public controlling parent. Funding stage stays on enrichment.fundingDetail.stage.

isAcquired.description: Operating status records an acquisition; null when no status is established.

isClosed.description: Stopped operating with no surviving business; null when no status is established.

isTerminal.description: Operating status is terminal; null when no status is established.

EntityProvider.description:
The current entity a fund or product/service is offered by: a fund's manager organization, a
        product/service's provider, through its current primary relationship to a live, publicly
        listed provider.
        Null on every other entity type.

entity.description: Provider core. Its image is the provider's own logo, else the logo of the provider's current parent entity.

relationshipType.description: Relationship linking the subject to this provider.

EntityListResearch.description: Research findings included in each entity list row, without snippet text.

acceleratorParticipation.description: Accelerator programs the entity took part in, derived from its accelerator research records

detail.description: Structured research details the caller is allowed to see

EntityAcceleratorParticipation.description: One accelerator program the entity took part in, from its acceleratorParticipant relationship, with the accelerator's own entity record.

accelerator.description: The accelerator's basic entity record, from the acceleratorParticipant relationship

acceleratorName.description: Full accelerator participation name, including program detail

asOfDate.description: Source-stated participation effective date or instant

id.description: Stable id of this participation, tied to the acceleratorParticipant relationship it comes from

program.description: Accelerator program name, when the source distinguishes one

EntityProfileHeadline.description: Profile headline derived from record kind, current market-standing ownership (Public or Private only), a Business Line's proven public controlling parent, and operating status. Never a funding stage. Render an unrecognized value verbatim.

EntityFundingDetail.description: Aggregate view of an entity's fundraising activity

applicability.description: RECORDED when an eligible financing amount, including an explicit zero, exists. Otherwise UNKNOWN for a company, investment firm, or unestablished kind; NOT_APPLICABLE for a fund, nonprofit, government, business line, product, or service with no recorded financing amount. Recorded financing history is preserved for every kind. Null or absent means this contract was not supplied, not that financing is unknown. totalRaised retains its legacy numeric type.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of totalRaised, latestValuation, and mostRecentAmount: the one currency every round uses, else the entity's own currency when rounds carry none. Null when rounds use more than one currency or no fundraise rollup exists, so these amounts have no single currency.

currentValuation.description: Selected eligible valuation with its own currency/basis/date, including standalone research evidence. Optional on older servers; absence is not zero.

disclosedStage.description: Latest explicitly recorded equity ladder label retained in a transaction's source round field, not calculatedRoundLabel or a Late Stage Private inference. Null when no canonical disclosed ladder label is recorded; does not assert market standing.

disclosedStageTransactionId.description: Transaction retaining disclosedStage; read its history/source, not a current listing assertion.

fundingRoundCount.description: Recorded round count, including rounds with no recorded amount.

latestValuation.description: Legacy latest-transaction valuation; not a current observation or USD value. Use currentValuation.

totalRaised.description: Sum of recorded round amounts in their original currencies, excluding rounds with no amount; not a complete lifetime total when amounts are missing. Use totalRaisedUsd for a USD aggregate; totalRaised has no single currency when currency is null. Legacy numeric projection: zero also represents unknown or inapplicable financing; read applicability before displaying it. This field remains numeric until all supported readers accept nullable totals.

totalRaisedAmountRoundCount.description: Eligible totalRaisedUsd rounds with a recorded amount, including an explicit zero. Subtract from totalRaisedRoundCount for undisclosed amounts. Null means unknown coverage.

totalRaisedRoundCount.description: Deduplicated rounds eligible for totalRaisedUsd, including undisclosed amounts. Uses exactly that total's acquisition/bankruptcy exclusions; unlike fundingRoundCount, this is the coverage denominator. Null until coverage is available.

totalRaisedUsd.description: USD aggregate at enrichment.fundingDetail.totalRaisedUsd: sums only recorded round amounts with an announcement-date ECB/World Bank rate. Excludes rounds with no amount or no rate, so do not report it as a complete lifetime total when either is missing. Null when no eligible amount converts or coverage is not available; a converted recorded zero remains zero. Use totalRaisedRoundCount, totalRaisedAmountRoundCount and totalRaisedUsdRoundCount for coverage of this same deduplicated eligible set, never fundingRoundCount as its denominator.

totalRaisedUsdRoundCount.description: Eligible totalRaisedUsd rounds whose recorded amount has a USD conversion, including converted zero. Subtract from totalRaisedAmountRoundCount for missing FX. Null means unknown coverage; zero means no converted amount is known.

unconvertedRoundCount.description: Rounds with an amount but no announcement-date USD rate, excluded from totalRaisedUsd. Does not count rounds with no recorded amount; zero does not prove the total is complete.

FundingApplicability.description: Whether financing amounts are recorded, unknown, or inapplicable.

EntityValuation.description: Current eligible valuation with its own amount, basis, currency and source date.

amount.description: Native source amount as a plain decimal JSON string, preserving stored precision without JSON-number rounding or Long truncation.

asOfDate.description: Source-effective year, month, day or timestamp; null when the observation is undated.

basis.description: Source-stated basis; null when legacy evidence did not state one. Reported is not silently post-money.

currency.description: The observation's own ISO currency. Null means unknown, never the entity currency or USD.

postMoneyUsd.description: Post-money amount in USD as a plain decimal JSON string under the existing ECB/World Bank conversion policy; derived only from same-source pre-money plus raised when needed; null for pre-money-only without raised, unknown currency, or unavailable foreign-currency date/rate. Never substitutes an older observation.

referenceValue.description: Original research qualifier, retained without interpreting a fiscal/forecast period as currency.

FundingStage.description: Funding stage only, emitted by the entity fundraise rollup. The record headline is profileStatus.headline; the entity-type and operating-status members are deprecated as a headline and retire in a later contract change. Transaction classifications such as Debt, IPO, and Acquisition are not entity stages.

foundedYear.description: The year the entity was founded, when stored; absent for people and records without one.

nameAgreement.description: Strict canonical equality of the requested name and this entity's display brand, under the lookup's matching rules. Not a similarity, legal-name or alias proof. Absent for people, missing names, unavailable proof and older stored responses.

owner.description: Entity identity (entityId) or person identity (personId). record.typeRecord distinguishes a company, product, or service; read it with GET /v1/entities/{entityId} or GET /v1/people/{personId}.

probability.description: Confidence, 0 to 1, that this record is the subject: the one confidence to act on. Absent when an exact id, URL, slug, or registry-id match settled the answer, which needs no confidence, or when this record was not compared.

record.description: The record with its duplicate-check score and reasons; score 0 with no reason means only vector similarity proposed it.

updatedAt.description: When the stored record was last updated.

website.description: The record's current primary website URL as stored. Compare it to the subject's own url before trusting a same-name match; domainAgreement already does.

DomainConflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies which details shape a 409 response carries.

UrlHostFormResolution.description: Verified preferred host form of a submitted URL and any fresh HTTP evidence.

concluded.description: True when the profile platform owns the canonical URL form, or live evidence landed on the submitted apex/www host pair or exact submitted host.

crawlCdnProvider.description: Edge provider observed by this probe.

crawlRenderMode.description: Render requirement established from static and rendered readings of the same page.

landingHost.description: Host the live answer landed on after redirects; absent for other outcomes.

outcome.description: Typed outcome from the fresh probe; absent when no probe ran.

status.description: Fresh HTTP status or classified probe result; absent when no probe ran.

submittedUrl.description: The URL submitted for this probe.

url.description: Preferred same-site URL; submittedUrl when evidence is inconclusive.

EntityUrlCrawlCdnProvider.description: CDN or hosting provider fronting a web URL.

EntityUrlCrawlRenderMode.description: JavaScript rendering requirement for crawl checks.

SearchDuplicateCandidateScore.description: Duplicate candidate scoring result. Use id/name/slug/typeRecord/reason to decide whether the candidate is the requested record. score ranks review priority; it does not prove absence.

externalId.description: Matched external identifier when duplicate scoring used one.

id.description: Candidate id to read or update when this candidate is the requested record.

name.description: Candidate display name from the existing record.

operatingStatus.description: Current operating status for entity candidates.

publicPath.description: Public API/UI path for the candidate when available.

reason.description: Match reasons such as name-exact, slug-exact, url-match, url-current, url-type, or precomputed-similarity. url-match proves the supplied URL/domain matched; url-current additionally proves the candidate still holds that address today, so a candidate with url-match but no url-current matched only through a URL it no longer uses, such as an acquisition redirect. url-type only means the candidate has the same URL category and is review context, not URL identity evidence.

score.description: Ranking score for duplicate review. It is not an absence proof; a low score can still be the intended record when reason/name/slug/typeRecord match.

slug.description: Candidate slug from the existing record.

typeRecord.description: Candidate entity type from the existing record.

RegistryFiling.description: Facts a government registry filing (SEC Form D, IRS, HRSA, NPPES) states about the organization. A lookup weighs each stored record's former names, addresses, team, registry ids, and founded year against them and matches without any model call only at about 220:1 odds. Invalid for a person lookup.

address.description: Addresses the filing states: principal office, business, mailing.

incorporatedYear.description: Year of incorporation the filing states.

nameFormer.description: Earlier names the filing or registry states for this organization; the subject name is its current filed name.

person.description: People the filing names: executive officers, directors, promoters.

phone.description: Phone numbers the filing states, such as a federal contract's vendor phone. A searched website proves the organization's site when one of its pages states the name and the same ten digits.

uniqueId.description: Registry ids the filing states, such as secCik, ein, or npi. A record holding the same non-EIN id is strong evidence; an EIN is a reported tax assertion, never independent identity evidence. Filing or claiming a source requires verified tax-owner evidence before any write; unresolved EINs return review. A record holding a different exclusive id of the same type is a different filer.

UniqueIdMutation.description: Create or merge-patch an external identifier mapping. Omitted fields preserve existing values; listing qualifiers apply only to entity tickers. A new or changed EIN requires independently verified tax-owner evidence; an unheld number or source label does not establish ownership. Unchanged bindings and label-only patches preserve the existing tax identity.

effectiveFrom.description: Source-stated beginning of the ticker assignment at supplied precision.

effectiveTo.description: Source-stated end of the ticker assignment; absence does not mean current.

idType.description: Identifier type token, for example ein, secCik, or ticker.

identifier.description: Identifier value as issued by the registry.

listingStanding.description: Source-stated listing standing, not entity operating or ownership status.

shareClass.description: Source-stated ticker share class; never inferred from the symbol.

source.description: Optional attribution source label for the mapping.

standingAsOf.description: Date from which the source says this listing standing applies, at the precision supplied.

venue.description: Source-stated ticker venue, retaining exact spelling; unknown is absent.

RegistryFilingAddress.description: One address a registry filing states.

addressLine1.description: Street line, such as 6797 Winchester Circle.

RegistryFilingPerson.description: One person a registry filing names.

executiveOfficer.description: True when the filing names this person an executive officer.

HelpCitation.description: A single corpus document the help answer is grounded in.

billingAccess.description: What a caller without a paid plan gets from the cited operation; absent when the operation needs no plan. A resolve for such a caller ranks PAID_PLAN candidates after the others.

excerpt.description: Verbatim excerpt from the cited document supporting the answer.

sourceId.description: Stable id within the source type: an operationId, a skill/prompt name, a completion gate id, or a research detail type targetPath.

sourceType.description: Which part of the platform corpus this citation comes from.

sourceVersion.description: Immutable version of the cited document when one exists (skill/prompt content version); null for catalog-derived sources.

HelpResolution.description: Resolution of a request to a catalog task or an operation, clarification between candidates, or an abstention.

candidate.description: Candidate operations best first; the options to choose between when the outcome is CLARIFY.

operationId.description: The advised operation for OPERATION_ADVICE, or the write whose missing inputs a CLARIFY asks for.

outcome.description: Which of the mutually exclusive resolve outcomes was reached.

probability.description: Confidence, 0 to 1, in the chosen option (an operation, a catalog task, several, or none). A low-confidence choice becomes CLARIFY, listing the candidates.

taskKey.description: The chosen catalog task for TASK_PLAN, or the task leading a CLARIFY.

taskPlan.description: The chosen task's plan for TASK_PLAN when the caller may read catalog task plans; absent otherwise.

HarnessTaskPlan.description: One catalog task's typed inputs and ordered steps with derived CLI commands and MCP tools, read from the stated catalog revision.

catalogRevision.description: Stored catalog revision this plan was read from.

gateId.description: Ids of the completion checks this task must pass, as listed in the completion check catalog.

input.description: Typed task inputs; required inputs must be bound before it runs.

step.description: Steps in run order; an empty list means this catalog task is unplanned.

HarnessTaskInput.description: One typed task input, required unless explicitly marked optional.

allowedValue.description: Optional exact literal accepted for a TEXT input; when present, the run and its mutation guard require this value instead of accepting an arbitrary string.

description.description: What the value is, written for the caller that supplies it.

key.description: Input key, unique within its task.

required.description: Whether this input must be bound before admission. Defaults to true; an omitted optional input stays unbound and is never inferred from the prompt.

HarnessTaskPlanStep.description: One task step with the CLI command and MCP tool that run its operation.

cliCommand.description: CLI command path that runs the step's operation; the caller supplies required flags.

mcpTool.description: MCP tool that runs the step's operation; null for CLI-only operations. Supply arguments matching the tool's schema.

title.description: Display title supplied by the stored step.

writeGuidance.description: What the server expects of the prose this step writes, derived from the operation's judged prose type when the plan is read; null when the step writes no judged prose.

HarnessTaskStep.description: One ordered task step: its key, instruction, the operation that runs it, and the delegated plans it follows.

instruction.description: What this step does, written for the agent that runs it.

operationId.description: OpenAPI operationId this step calls; it must be in the task's operation list.

planTaskKey.description: Agent-task keys whose plans this step follows instead of restating their steps: the task then owns each named plan's steps, so a write one of them commits counts for this task too. Each must name another planned task; a key may appear once per task and delegations must not loop.

publishesAnalysis.description: Whether this step must supply an analysis section when its task publishes an article analysis. Optional lens steps already require a section when accepted.

stepKey.description: Step key, unique within its task.

title.description: Display title for this step, when the catalog supplies one.

HarnessTaskWriteGuidance.description: The expectation, body, type hints, rejections, override, and method for one judged prose write.

body.description: The request body keys, the key that carries the prose, and a minimal JSON example.

expectation.description: The one sentence the prose aims for.

method.description: Help sections that teach this prose, each with the command that retrieves it.

override.description: The override field, the problems it may waive, and its terms.

reject.description: Each problem that rejects this prose: what fails it and the fix.

typeCatalog.description: The read operation that returns per-type hints for this write; call it first.

HarnessTaskInputType.description: NEWS is a public article, given by its aVenture news id; ENTITY is a target entity, identified and given by its aVenture id; TEXT is a literal value the request states; FACT is one source-bound claim to research; WRITER_BRIEF is the typed research analysis a prose writer composes from (claim ledger, positioning frame, paragraph plan).

BillingAccessType.description: What a caller without a paid plan gets. `PAID_PLAN`: nothing; the operation answers 402 subscription_required until the caller subscribes. `DAILY_ALLOWANCE`: a free UTC-day allowance, then 402 subscription_required until it refills.

HelpSourceType.description: Which part of the help material a citation comes from.

HelpScope.description: Operation scope a help answer may recommend: read-only, write, or all.

EntityValuationTimeSeriesPoint.description: A single valuation datapoint. `valuationPostMoney` is the canonical charted value; filled when directly recorded or safely derivable from pre-money + amount raised (same currency only). `derivation` explains whether the value was stored or inferred. Only `researchDetail` points have a `detailId` and can be changed here; `fundraiseRound` points are changed through fundraise-round commands.

amountRaised.description: Amount raised in the same currency, only for fundraise rows.

asOfDate.description: Source-stated effective date for this valuation datapoint.

decimalValue.description: Valuation of a research detail exactly as the source states it, as a decimal string; the older whole-number value is only an approximation of it.

declaredBasis.description: Basis declared by the original source.

derivation.description: How pre-money and post-money fields were obtained.

detailId.description: Research detail id for stated valuation rows. Null for fundraise-derived rows, which cannot be updated or deleted on this valuation surface.

label.description: Fundraise round label or legacy detail display text, when present.

source.description: Where the point came from: a research detail or a funding round.

valuationPostMoney.description: Post-money valuation in full currency units, when known.

valuationPreMoney.description: Pre-money valuation in full currency units, when known.

EntityValuationDerivation.description: How the point's valuationPostMoney and valuationPreMoney were obtained.

EntityUrlType.description: Canonical URL platform type such as website, linkedin, twitter, or github. Lifecycle facts belong on link flags such as isCurrent and isPrimary.

UniqueIdType.description: External identifier type that maps an owner to a well-known registry id.

ContentCompliance.description: Character and word counts for the text, and whether it meets its text type's rules (word and character limits and paragraph shape). violation lists each unmet rule and is empty when the text meets them all.

characterCount.description: Character count of the row text (UTF-16 units).

meetsRequirements.description: Whether the text meets every length and paragraph rule for its type.

violation.description: One human-readable reason per unmet rule; empty when compliant.

wordCount.description: Word count of the row text (whitespace-separated tokens).

SlugResource.description: Resource type whose slug is being changed

EntitySimilaritySummary.description: Short similar-entity card: core identity, current URL links, funding totals, and why it counts as similar. Use EntitySimilarityResult for full EntityList rows.

fundingDetail.description: Funding totals, so similar companies compare without one read each

urlLink.description: Current primary URL links, one per URL type

ResearchDerivedRange.description: Read-only time range computed for targetDateAbsolute research details

asOfDate.description: Observation date from the source detail row

bucket.description: Derived bucket using inclusive 0, 3, 6, 12, and 24 month boundaries

monthsFromNow.description: Whole months from now() to targetDate

targetDate.description: Absolute target date stored for a targetDateAbsolute detail row

ResearchDerivedBucket.description: Bucket computed from now() to the target date with inclusive boundaries at 0, 3, 6, 12, and 24 months

GithubRepo.description: GitHub repository synced for an entity or person from their current github URL links. githubId is GitHub's stable numeric repository id; rows are replaced per owner on each sync, so counts and timestamps reflect the last sync.

githubId.description: GitHub's stable numeric repository id; each sync uses it to match and update the owner's repository record

homepageUrl.description: Project homepage URL declared on the repository

isArchived.description: True when the repository is archived on GitHub

isFork.description: True when the repository is a fork of another repository

license.description: SPDX license id reported by GitHub

name.description: Repository name (slug segment after the login)

ownerLogin.description: GitHub account login (org or user) the repository belongs to

repoPushedAt.description: GitHub pushed_at of the repository at last sync

url.description: Canonical https GitHub repository page URL

LogoAccuracy.description: Read-only assessment of whether a stored logo/photo depicts the target's own brand, decided from visible features of the stored mark versus the target's own reference marks

candidateObserved.description: Literal visible description of the candidate mark, when assessed by vision

outcome.description: Whether the candidate mark matches the target's own brand

reference.description: Reference marks fetched from the target's own surfaces, each with its perceptual-hash distance to the candidate. The deciding deterministic distance is the smallest entry

referenceObserved.description: Literal visible description of the reference mark, when assessed by vision

sharedFeature.description: The specific visible feature shared by candidate and reference that supports a match (shared name text, symbol, or distinctive palette); null when not a match

MediaObjectType.description: Target domain for media operations (logos, pictures, thumbnails)

LogoAccuracyMethod.description: How a logo-accuracy outcome was reached

LogoAccuracyReference.description: A reference mark from the target's own surface and its distance to the candidate

hammingDistance.description: Perceptual-hash distance between the candidate and this reference

url.description: Direct URL of the reference mark fetched from the target's surface

PersonInvestorParticipation.description: Person investor with round participation labels and count

EntityInvestorParticipation.description: Entity investor with round participation and enrichment data (addresses, URLs)

InvestorPortfolio.description: Current public-detail-visible recipients of this investor's direct and current primary managed-fund participations, excluding bankruptcy proceedings and funds without public-detail visibility. Counts are distinct recipients in the selected current-status cohort, not investor holdings, dated exits, realized returns or losses. Both pages use the requested page and size independently; their totals and coverage describe the complete cohort.

ambiguousSectorCount.description: Recipients with more than one distinct current primary industry.

classifiedRecipientCount.description: Recipients with exactly one current primary editorial industry.

observedAt.description: Database snapshot read time; not the date of an exit, closure or investment.

rankableRecipientCount.description: Recipients with a recorded USD capital-raised aggregate. Its round/amount/FX coverage remains on each recipient's funding object. Not a count of known returns.

recipient.description: Complete selected recipient population, paged in descending recorded funding.totalRaisedUsd order (unknown last), then entity id. Capital raised is only a declared ordering proxy, not exit consideration or investor success. Funding coverage and missing values must remain visible. Closed/inactive recipients do not establish a realized loss, cause of failure or historical rate.

sector.description: Exclusive single-primary editorial industry groups, ordered by recipient count descending then canonical industry id. Missing and ambiguous industries are counted separately, never assigned the first tag. Page totalElements counts groups.

unknownSectorCount.description: Recipients with no current primary editorial industry.

StageFrequency.description: Equity stage computed from each round's calculatedRoundLabel, with how many deals reached it, most frequent first.

InvestorPortfolioSector.description: One exclusive primary editorial industry group.

EntityTag.description: Classification tag. Catalog and search responses describe the tag itself; entity classification responses also carry classificationId and the entity's current and primary flags.

bucket.description: Classification bucket key; tag search and the classification catalog accept this value as `type`.

classificationId.description: Id of this classification on the entity; null in catalog and search results.

createdAt.description: Tag creation timestamp, not the time the entity received this tag.

isCurrent.description: In catalog and search results, whether the tag is active; in entity classification responses, whether the classification is current for the entity.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the entity's primary classification in its bucket; null in catalog and search results.

updatedAt.description: Tag update timestamp, not the time the entity's classification changed.

name.description: Display name. Capped to the standardized taxonomy storage limit because this shared read contract covers NAICS/SIC/ISIC-style classification labels as well as editorial tags.

registry.description: Join registry this classification belongs to; pass it as registry when reading or changing the join by classificationId.

ClassificationJoinRegistry.description: Which kind of entity classification an id belongs to, editorial or standardized; needed on paths where the two kinds can share the same id number.

InvestorPortfolioRecipient.description: A portfolio recipient and the funding aVenture has recorded for it.

FundraiseFinancialInstrumentType.description: Fundraise financial instrument type — the vehicle a round or investor join used

FundraiseRoundField.description: A funding round field a write asserted that its cited source did not support.

HarnessChassis.description: Agent framework a research run executes on: the Claude Agent SDK or the Pi agent SDK

HarnessRunExecution.description: Executor of the accepted research work; independent of its requested scope

HarnessRunLane.description: Queue priority of a run: live (search and lookup) and interactive (one client run) share the interactive queue; bulk (client batch) and background (system backlog) share the background queue

HarnessLlmApi.description: Language-model API format a run's calls use: Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions, or OpenAI Responses

ResearchAllowanceType.description: Metered allowance. `COMPANY` and `PERSON` meter research runs on company and person-profile targets; `ENTITY_VIEW`, `ENTITY_BRAND`, and `PERSON_VIEW` meter profile and brand reads. Directory exports share `ENTITY_VIEW` for company and investor rows and `PERSON_VIEW` for person rows, once per record per UTC month with detail views; `WEB_SEARCH` meters web searches.

HarnessResearchOutcome.description: How unsuccessful research ended: PARTIAL (some of it finished) or BLOCKED

HarnessRunType.description: Research run kind: a caller-filed research request or a narrower scheduled run

StandardizedClassification.description: Industry or ownership classification from a standard taxonomy such as NAICS, SIC, or ISIC, with its category, code, and hierarchy level.

classificationId.description: Id of this classification on the entity; null in catalog and search results.

code.description: Legacy numeric standardized code when present; does not establish codeText or edition.

codeText.description: Exact source-stated code text; null is unrecorded, never reconstructed from code.

edition.description: Source-stated codebook edition; null is unknown, never an assumed current edition.

isCurrent.description: Whether the entity's classification join is current; false retains historical context. Catalog and search reference rows are current by definition.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the entity's primary classification in this category.

registry.description: Join registry this classification belongs to; pass it as registry when reading or changing the join by classificationId.

BlogPostType.description: Where a collected blog post came from

AddressAssociation.description: One role and effective period for a physical address association

endDate.description: Last known day this role applied

isCurrent.description: Whether this role is currently relevant

role.description: Address association role; null means unclassified

startDate.description: First known day this role applied

AddressCity.description: City reference used inside an address

AddressCountry.description: Country reference used inside an address

AddressState.description: State or region reference used inside an address

AddressAssociationRole.description: Meaning of an entity or person address association. Dominant is the operating headquarters; domicile is the legal or registered seat and is not evidence of operational presence; origin is the founding or historical location.

EntityAcquisitionEvidence.description: Booleans confirming each managed row written by the acquisition endpoint.

EntityAcquisitionStage.description: Acquisition stage/status values used by acquisition APIs and fundraise rollups. Acquisition is neutral before operating-status change; Acquired Subsidiary is completed and still operating; Acquired is terminal or folded, including Closed (Acquihire).

enum: Announced; subject to approvals and closing conditions

ResearchParagraphShape.description: Paragraph rules that text must meet when written. Paragraphs split on `\n\n` (one blank line). Each paragraph must satisfy minChars..maxChars and minSentences..maxSentences; whole body must satisfy minParagraphs..maxParagraphs (null maxParagraphs = unbounded). Sentence boundaries follow Unicode rules (java.text.BreakIterator), so 'Inc.' and 'U.S.' do not split a sentence. Each paragraph ends in terminal punctuation (. ! ? or the CJK full stop, exclamation, and question marks), optionally followed by a closing quote, parenthesis, bracket, or guillemet.

maxClaimWords.description: Maximum words across the statements of the claims one planned writer paragraph states (paragraph.claim); null means unbounded.

maxParagraphs.description: Maximum paragraph count (inclusive); null means unbounded.

SecListingProspectus.description: The final IPO prospectus a registrant filed on SEC EDGAR.

documentUrl.description: SEC EDGAR Archives URL of the prospectus document.

form.description: SEC form type of the prospectus.

EmployeeCountRange.description: Inclusive range applied to one current workforce observation.

matchMode.description: Omitted or numeric matches only reported numbers, including exact-count estimates. overlap matches any intersection with a reported band; containment requires its whole interval within these bounds. Open upper bands cannot fit a finite maximum. Without either bound this entry is a no-op in every mode.

EntityFundraiseFilterCriteria.description: Fundraise and investment filters for entity search

amountInvestedRange.description: Investor-level check amounts in the transaction currency, not the round's total raise. Use investedAmountRaisedRange for a named portfolio company's round total. Use plain JSON numbers.

amountRaisedRange.description: Per-round amounts raised by the returned entity itself in USD, not a portfolio company's round total. Use investedAmountRaisedRange for the latter. Use plain JSON numbers.

dateAnnouncedRange.description: Inclusive announcement timestamp bounds on the same fundraise transaction as round and amountRaisedRange. Announcement dates do not establish funding completion dates.

dateFundingCompleteRange.description: Inclusive funding completion timestamp bounds on the same fundraise transaction as round, amountRaisedRange, and investor constraints. Calendar-only completion dates must fit entirely within the bounds.

investedAmountRaisedRange.description: Total amounts raised in USD by a named portfolio company's rounds, not an investor's individual check or its own fundraising. Requires nonblank investedCompanyName. Company, investedRound, and this amount match the same portfolio-company transaction.

investedCompanyName.description: Portfolio company brand, legal or canonical names, or a bare domain exactly matching a current WEBSITE root URL (not broad host discovery; no URL paths or queries). A bare-domain miss never falls back to a name. Returns their investors with investedRound, when supplied, bound to the same company transaction regardless of its age.

investedCountry.description: Countries of the companies an investor backed, as country names or ids; a deal matches when its company's current headquarters is in one of them. Restricts returned entities to investors with such a deal inside the investment-activity horizon; the same deal must match investedIndustry and, when investedCompanyName is empty, investedRound.

investedIndustry.description: Industry terms for the companies an investor backed, such as Software, Artificial Intelligence, or Fintech; a term matches a portfolio company whose industry or industry classification name contains it as whole words, case-insensitively. Restricts returned entities to investors with such a deal inside the investment-activity horizon; with investedRound and no investedCompanyName, the same deal must match both.

investedRound.description: Round labels of deals an investor joined, such as Seed or Series A; with investedCompanyName matches those companies' transactions regardless of age, otherwise matches deals inside the investment-activity horizon.

investorEntityId.description: Investor entity ids. Restricts returned entities to the portfolio the investor's own investments list shows: fundraises it joined directly or through a fund it currently manages as primary manager.

investorName.description: Deprecated for organizations: select a firm or fund by investorEntityId. It stays the only selector for an individual (angel) investor, matched by exact full name, until an investor person id filter replaces it. Investor names. Each resolves to at most one investor entity, whose portfolio investorEntityId would select: a live Investment Firm or Fund whose brand or alias equals it ignoring case and punctuation, else the entity with the most recorded investments whose brand, legal name, or alias equals it, else the public entity whose brand the name begins as whole words ("Sequoia") holding many times the recorded investments of every other such entity (Sequoia Capital). A name also matches an individual investor's exact full name.

investorNameMatch.description: How investorEntityId ids and investorName names combine: any (default) returns companies one named investor backed; every returns companies every named investor backed, each in any of the company's fundraises.

lastRoundYearRange.description: Last-round-year ranges for each entity's most recent fundraise round.

rankByInvestmentActivity.description: True ranks returned investors by recent deal activity ahead of any sort: each deal matching investedIndustry, investedCountry, and (when investedCompanyName is empty) investedRound adds a weight that decays to zero over the investment-activity horizon, nudged by the investor's known USD check. Restricts returned entities to investors with such a deal.

round.description: Fundraise round labels, such as Seed or Series A.

totalRaisedRange.description: Total-raised ranges across all rounds in USD. Use plain JSON numbers.

EntityFilterLogoOption.description: Logo sort priority for entity search

EntityOperatingStatus.description: Operating state accepted by entity filters and mutation endpoints. Acquired Subsidiary means the entity was acquired and still operates; Closed (Acquihire) means the entity was acquired for its team and is terminal, rendering like Closed everywhere; Acquired means the entity is terminal, folded into the buyer, or closed.

EntityListQualityGate.description: Extra check on listed entities. COMPANY_LISTING_READY returns only operating companies and business lines that have a real (not generated) logo, a founding year, a current headquarters, and recorded positive funding with a stage; NONE applies no extra check.

StandardizedClassificationFilter.description: Exact standardized reference tuple. All supplied fields match one reference; no edition filter means any edition, hasEdition=false selects unknown edition.

category.description: Existing standardized category; no inferred namespace.

code.description: Exact legacy numeric code; may match multiple editions unless edition is constrained.

codeText.description: Exact source-stated code text, never reconstructed from numeric code.

edition.description: Exact supplied codebook edition; omitted does not assume the current edition.

hasEdition.description: true selects recorded editions; false selects unknown edition; omit it to match either.

EntityUniqueIdFilter.description: Public-registry identifier predicate: entities holding an identifier in this namespace, or this exact identifier when identifier is supplied. Private namespaces are refused.

idType.description: Public identifier type token, for example secCik, ein, or ticker.

identifier.description: Exact identifier in that namespace; omitted matches any recorded value.

UrlMatchMode.description: URL matching mode for URL-backed filters and duplicate checks.

DateRange.description: ISO-8601 timestamp range for temporal filters.

InvestorNameMatchMode.description: How investorName names combine: any (default) returns companies backed by any named investor; every returns companies backed by every named investor, across fundraises.

EmployeeCountMatchMode.description: How the requested bounds match the selected current workforce observation.

ResearchValueShapeType.description: Closed write-time value shape token. Shape, not valueType, selects which write fields and validation rules apply.

EntityComparisonSignals.description: Competitive comparison signals for a provider entity — sells-to customers, pricing model, ownership, funding stage, total raised, and website. Taken from the entity's additional data for side-by-side comparison; the founding year is in the entity's core fields.

acquirer.description: Public buyer of the newest completed acquisition; null for announced or non-public buyers.

disclosedStage.description: Disclosed equity ladder label from fundingDetail.disclosedStage; financing history, not the provider operating status or current market standing.

ownership.description: Provider ownership from current tags and current primary parent or acquirer relationships

profileStatus.description: Derived profile status of the provider

sellsTo.description: Customer types the provider sells to (current typeCustomer tags)

totalRaised.description: Total capital raised in USD, each round converted at its announcement-date rate; null when no round converts to USD or no funding is known

RelationshipDirection.description: How entities relationships create interprets sourceEntityId and targetEntityId.

choiceOptionTruncated.description: Whether additional eligible choices exist beyond choiceOption

limit.description: Maximum entities sampled for displayed choices.

DomainConflictDetails.description: Details of an HTTP 409 conflict. conflictType names the shape: URL_DUPLICATE when the URL is already a current URL on another record; STRICT_URL_LOOKUP when an exact URL lookup matches more than one record; DUPLICATE_CREATE_REVIEW when a create or lookup returns candidate records to review; CLASSIFICATION_INACTIVE_TAG when a classification value exists but is inactive; NEWS_SOURCE_URL when another article already has the same publication and URL.

conflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies this details shape.

ProseViolation.description: One rejected passage and one problem it shows; a passage with several problems appears once per problem.

overridable.description: Whether proseOverrideReason can accept this problem; ProblemDetail.hint says when an override is allowed.

passage.description: The rejected sentence or paragraph, the whole text for a global text-contract violation, or the source URL for a legal-page source.

reason.description: Why the passage was rejected and how to fix it.

supportedWording.description: Present only on a writerBrief grounding refusal with unsupportedSpan: the passage without those clauses, which its cited quotes support. Absent when that remaining wording is still refused.

unsupportedSpan.description: Present only on a writerBrief grounding refusal of a statement with several clauses: the clauses its cited quotes do not support. Absent when every clause or none is refused.

ProblemResolution.description: Machine-readable next action for an aVenture ProblemDetail. For reviewCandidates, inspect ProblemDetail.details candidates and decide update, create-with-override, or block from those returned records.

acceptedValue.description: Accepted values for the field or parameter, when enumerable.

action.description: Next action category for the client or agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint to call for the next action, when applicable.

fieldPath.description: Request-body field path that needs attention, when applicable.

parameter.description: Query or path parameter that needs attention, when applicable.

retryable.description: Whether the same logical request can be retried after the next action.

UrlDuplicateConflict.description: Typed extension on ProblemDetail.details for HTTP 409 when a create/update attempts to set a URL with urlType=website (or another exclusive urlType) that is already a current URL on a different entity or person. The existingJoin list names every current owner of the normalized URL; inspect its identity before changing ownership. A person holds one current LinkedIn person profile (/in/<slug>): a different one answers this conflict with existingJoin naming the person's own held row. An offering sharing its provider's homepage uses the provider relationship without a duplicate URL row.

conflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies this details shape.

existingJoin.description: Every entity or person that already has this URL (after normalization) with this urlType. Non-empty when this conflict is emitted.

fragmentIgnored.description: True when URL fragment differences were ignored during duplicate matching (i.e., the conflict ignores everything after '#').

guidance.description: Human-readable guidance on how to resolve the conflict. Defaults to the standard identity and URL ownership checks.

normalizedUrl.description: Normalized URL match key used for duplicate detection. Null when normalization could not produce a stable key (e.g., malformed input).

requestedOwner.description: Entity or person you tried to add the URL to.

url.description: Raw URL as submitted by the caller (pre-normalization).

urlType.description: URL type submitted by the caller (e.g., 'website', 'twitter'). The conflict applies only within this urlType.

StrictUrlLookupConflict.description: Typed extension on ProblemDetail.details for HTTP 409 when a strict URL lookup (GET /v1/entities/lookup-exact?url=...) resolves to more than one current owner. The candidate lists return every current owner that matches the normalized URL key; the caller must add disambiguating signals (urlType, typeRecord, slug) to resolve to a single owner.

candidateEntityId.description: Every entity id that currently owns the normalized URL. May be empty when the conflict is between persons; combined with candidatePersonId always > 1.

candidatePersonId.description: Every person id that currently owns the normalized URL. May be empty when the conflict is between entities; combined with candidateEntityId always > 1.

conflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies this details shape.

hint.description: Human-readable hint describing which disambiguating query parameters to add.

normalizedUrl.description: Normalized URL match key the lookup resolved against. Null when normalization could not produce a stable key.

url.description: Raw URL the caller queried.

urlType.description: URL type the caller specified, or null if the lookup did not constrain by urlType.

DuplicateCreateReview.description: Candidate-review conflict details returned in ProblemDetail.details for create gates and deterministic lookup ambiguity. The returned candidates are the decision surface: update the matching candidate, create with duplicate override only when every candidate is distinct from the source-backed target, or block when identity is unresolved. score and threshold rank review priority; they are not proof that the requested record is absent.

candidate.description: Entity/person candidates returned by lookup or create duplicate review. If a candidate is the requested record, read/update that candidate by id. Create with duplicate override only after every candidate is reviewed as distinct.

conflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies this details shape.

newsCandidate.description: News candidates returned by lookup or create duplicate review. If a candidate is the requested article, read/update that article by id. Otherwise block until source evidence proves a distinct article.

overridePath.description: Create endpoint to retry only after reviewing the returned candidates and supplying overrideGate=duplicate and overrideReason as query parameters. Null for detail lookup ambiguity, where the next action is review/update/block.

threshold.description: Review threshold used by duplicate scoring. Scores below this value can still be useful candidate context; this value does not prove absence or authorize create.

ClassificationInactiveTagDetails.description: ProblemDetail.details for HTTP 409 when a classification value exists but is inactive.

availableOverrides.description: Allowed inactiveTagOverride values for this conflict

conflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies this details shape.

slug.description: Existing dormant value slug or lookup key

NewsSourceUrlConflict.description: Typed extension on ProblemDetail.details for HTTP 409 when a news mutation's publication + newsUrlOriginal pair already belongs to another article. The returned fields identify the existing article so the caller can read/update it instead of creating a duplicate.

conflictType.description: Conflict kind that identifies this details shape.

conflictingArticleId.description: Id of the existing article that already has this publication and URL.

conflictingArticleSlug.description: Existing article slug, or empty string when the existing article has no slug. Use with GET /v1/news/lookup?slug= to fetch the conflicting article.

conflictingArticleTitle.description: Existing article title for human-readable diagnostics.

EntityClassificationInactiveTagOverride.description: Caller-chosen handling when the canonical classification value exists but is dormant.

NewsCandidateScore.description: Duplicate candidate scoring result for news articles. Use id/slug/externalId/reason to decide whether the candidate is the requested article. score ranks review priority; it does not prove absence.

externalId.description: Matched external article identifier when duplicate scoring used one.

id.description: News article id to read or update when this candidate is the requested article.

publicationScore.description: Portion of score contributed by the publication match alone; 0 when the publication did not match. A candidate whose score minus publicationScore falls below the review threshold matched only on its outlet, not its story.

reason.description: Match reasons for reviewing the candidate. Exact reasons are decision signals regardless of whether score crosses the review threshold.

score.description: Ranking score for duplicate review. It is not an absence proof; a low score can still be the intended article when reason/slug/externalId match.

slug.description: Candidate article slug from the existing record.

UrlDuplicateJoin.description: Entity or person that currently has this URL (after normalization).

owner.description: Owner of the URL: either entityId or personId is populated depending on the owner kind. Use the populated id to read or update the owner's URL.

urlId.description: Identifier of the existing URL record that already holds this address.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per client IP in the current rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left before the tightest applicable rate-limit bucket rejects.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the exhausted rate-limit bucket admits another request; 0 when none is exhausted.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a throttled (424, 429) or temporarily unavailable (503) request.
